body.description: Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
body.name: Skull and Bones
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Brotherhood of Bones Outfits]].

body.description: You killed the raging mage in his tower south of Zao. Again. But this one just keeps coming back. The dimensional portal collapsed once more and you know he will eventually return but hey - a raging mage, it's like asking for it...
body.name: Mageslayer
body.relatedpages: [[Raging Mage]], [[Energized Raging Mage]], [[Yielothax Dimension]], [[The Mage's Tower World Change]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing the [[Energized Raging Mage]] twice.

body.description: By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
body.name: Lion King
body.relatedpages: [[Lion's Rock Quest]], [[The Lion's Heart]], [[Noble Lion]], [[Noble Lion (Mount)]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Noble Lion]].

body.description: The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
body.name: Final Strike
body.spoiler: Obtained after opening the treasure chest of [[Deathstrike]] for the first time after slaying it.

body.description: Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
body.name: Rhino Rider
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Stone Rhino]].

body.description: You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
body.name: Bibliomaniac
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Flying Book (Mount)|Flying Book]].

body.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
body.name: Crystals in Love
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the ''matchmaker'' mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: You're considered a first-rate graduate of the Magic Academy in Edron due to your pioneering discoveries and successful studies in the field of experimental magic and spell development. Ever considered teaching the Armageddon spell?
body.name: Alumni
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of the male [[Mage Outfits|Mage Outfit]] or female [[Summoner Outfits|Summoner Outfit]].

body.description: You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
body.name: Loyal Subject
body.spoiler: Say "Hello King" to [[King Tibianus]] during the [[Kingsday Mini World Change]].

body.description: Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small.
body.name: Bearhugger
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the second mission in the [[Barbarian Test Quest]].

body.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
body.name: Prison Break
body.spoiler: Obtained by helping to kill [[Gaz'haragoth]].

body.description: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
body.name: Mystic Fabric Magic
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of the [[Elementalist Outfits]].

body.description: You've entered the lair of Devovorga and joined the crew trying to take her down - whether crowned with success or not doesn't matter, but they can't blame you for not trying!
body.name: Daring Trespasser
body.spoiler: Obtainable by entering [[Devovorga]]'s lair on Vengoth, during the [[Rise of Devovorga]] Quest.

body.description: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
body.name: Death on Strike
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening [[Deathstrike]]'s chest 50 times.

body.description: Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated Hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
body.name: Inquisition's Arm
body.relatedpages: [[Grave Danger Quest]], [[King Zelos]], [[Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of the [[Hand of the Inquisition Outfits]].

body.description: You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout!
body.name: Talented Dancer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing Mission 3 of [[Unnatural Selection Quest]].

body.description: Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
body.name: Elven Woods
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Ab'Dendriel]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
body.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Fazzrah]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Fazzrah]].

body.description: You were able to fight your way through the countless hordes in the Demon Forge. Once more you proved that nothing is impossible.
body.name: Master of the Nexus
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Inquisition Quest]].

body.description: Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
body.name: Beneath the Sea
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Manta Ray]].

body.description: You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
body.name: Race to the Pole
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Hrodmir]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
body.name: The Spirit of Purity
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Spirit of Purity]].

body.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
body.history: Before [[Updates/9.53|update 9.53]], this achievement used to be called '''Best There Was!'''
body.name: King of the Ring
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Bretzecutioner]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Bretzecutioner]].

body.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
body.name: Hive War Veteran
body.spoiler: Obtainable after earning 500 War Exp in [[War Against the Hive Quest]].

body.description: You're a talented merchant who's able to handle wares with care, finds good offers and digs up rares every now and then. Never late to complete an order, you're a reliable trader - at least in Rashid's eyes.
body.name: Recognised Trader
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[The Travelling Trader Quest]].

body.description: So much for your feathered little friend! Maybe standing in front of the birdcage, squeezing its neck and shouting 'Sing! Sing! Sing!' was a little too much for it?!
body.name: Oops
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[birdcage]] until the bird dies from a heart attack.

body.description: By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
body.name: The Right Tone
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Crystal Wolf]].

body.description: Not fearing death or ghosts you have traveled with the ghost captain several times and are a seasoned traveler of the netherworld. The dead and the living whisper about your exploits with appreciation.
body.name: Nether Pirate
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing 10 journeys in [[A Pirate's Death to Me]].

body.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
body.name: You Got Horse Power
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Phantasmal Jade]] [[mount]].

body.description: You have your principles and that is also reflected in your vote for the crew of the Great Expedition.
body.name: Principled
body.spoiler: Vote for the same choice (A or B) 7 days in a row

body.description: You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team.
body.name: High Inquisitor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Inquisition Quest]].

body.description: You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either.
body.name: Friend of the Apes
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Ape City Quest]].

body.description: You don't carry that stake just for decoration - you're prepared to use it. Usually you're seen hightailing through the deepest dungeons leaving a trail of slain demons. Whoever dares stand in your way should prepare to die.
body.name: Demonbane
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Demon Hunter Outfits]].

body.description: On the shoulders of demons, you tore through veils of venomous corruption. Demonic essences made you an unstoppable force but take care to also foster your human side.
body.name: Tear the Toxic Veil
body.relatedpages: [[No Rest for the Wicked Quest]], [[Demonic Core Essence]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by reaching rank 10 in the [[No Rest for the Wicked Quest]] (delivering 51,200 [[Demonic Core Essence]]s).

body.description: You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
body.name: Publicity
body.spoiler: Obtainable by delivering [[Airtight Cloth]]s to [[Yeo]], [[Nicholas]], [[Barazbaz]], [[Alaistar]], [[Fayla]] and [[Christine]] after completing the first two parts of {{Spoiler Section|Glooth Factory Quest|The Gloud Ship}}.

body.description: Sleeping - you do it with style. You're chilling in your hammock, listening to the sound of the birds and crickets as you slowly drift away into the realm of dreams.
body.name: Rock Me to Sleep
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a hammock 100 times (logging out).

body.description: A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
body.name: Liberty Bay Watch
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Vandura]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
body.name: Top TBI Agent
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Secret Service Quest]] for the [[TBI]] faction.

body.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
body.name: Toothfairy Assistant
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Tooth Fairy]] part of the [[Threatened Dreams Quest]] and then delivering all the teeth requested by the same NPC.

body.description: This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
body.name: Way to Hell
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Magma Crawler]].

body.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
body.name: Honorary Gnome
body.spoiler: Obtainable by reaching rank IV of [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: You freed the remnants of the Order of the Stag on the Isle of Ada from a warlock's yoke. An evil puppet master who lead many Stags against their own brethren. Eldoran the Ambitious, heir of Eldoran Etzel, Cadwgan's bastard son, is forever grateful.
body.name: Bastard
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing [[The Order of the Stag Quest]].

body.description: Being the captain is as much a privilege to some as it is a burden to others. You took the helm by doing everything to make the Great Expedition succeed. Steer clear of trouble, stay your course and a bright future will always be ahead of you!
body.name: Aye-aye, Captain!
body.spoiler: Obtain full [[Captains Outfits]]

body.description: You're one of the most dedicated Lightbearers - without you, the demons would have torn the veil between the worlds for sure. You've lit each and every basin, travelling high and low, pushing back the otherworldly forces. Let there be light!
body.name: True Lightbearer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by lighting every basin in the [[Lightbearer]] event.

body.description: You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
body.name: Corruption Contained
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Cults of Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You're an aspiring marble sculptor with promising skills - proven by the perfect little Tibiasula statue you shaped. One day you'll be really famous!
body.name: Marblelous
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making a [[Beautiful Marble Statue]] from a [[Piece of Marble Rock]].

body.description: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
body.name: Master Thief
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Thieves Guild Quest]].

body.description: You wiped out Orcus the Cruel in the Arena of Svargrond. You're still a bit green behind the ears, but there's some great potential.
body.name: Greenhorn
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Barbarian Arena Quest]] in the Greenhorn difficulty.

body.description: Well - the contents of that present weren't quite what you expected. With friends like these, who needs enemies?
body.name: Joke's on You
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening an [[Present (Explosive)|Explosive Present]].

body.description: You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
body.name: Diplomatic Immunity
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening [[Abyssador]]'s chest 50 times.

body.description: Sinister curses, evil magic - you don't shy away from punishing others by questionable means. Someone just gave you a strange look - now where's that needle again?
body.name: Dark Voodoo Priest
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using dworc [[Voodoo Doll]] on someone till bloodhit.

body.description: Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
body.name: Beautiful Agony
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Ethershreck]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Ethershreck]].

body.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
body.name: The Empire's Glory
body.spoiler: Obtainable by discovering [[Kilmaresh]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You've learned the way of the wilderness: its patience, its fury, its grace. As a feral trapper, you embody them all.
body.name: Feral Trapper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Feral Trapper Outfits]].

body.description: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
body.name: Fully Decayed
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Decaying Defender Outfits]].

body.description: The transcendence to a higher state of mind and existence in order to achieve inner peace has been amplified by various means throghout Medudri history. Among them a manifold of potions with varying potence - it seems some of them actually work...
body.name: Inner Peace
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking 100 [[Transcendence Potion]]s.

body.description: You, Sir or Lady, are a true alchemist. Conducting transmutating experiments to find every possible combination has been your secret passion since years and the results of your research are incredible. Science has just taken a leap thanks to you!
body.history: The existence of this achievement was first made public by {{Character|Hunter of Dragoes}} in {{Post|39151295|a post on the The Achievements Thread}} in the Gameplay board, more than 10 years after its implementation. The spoiler discovery was made in cooperation with {{Character|Lee kun}} and {{Character|Vinicius shocks}}. The achievement finally became obtainable with the [[Updates/12.67.10918|12.67.10918]] update, which removed the need to use a [[Cockroach Leg]] as well as a mysterious unknown item.
body.name: Transmutator
body.spoiler:
Obtainable after transmuting into all 22 possible creatures on the [[Alchemist Quarter]]'s Transmutator, {{Mapper Coords|text=here|127.195|121.171|10|4|1|0.250.25}}.

body.description: You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
body.name: Keeper of the 7 Keys
body.spoiler: Obtainable by solving all 7 key puzzles of [[The Dream Courts Quest]].

body.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
body.name: Depth Dwellers
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 300 [[Deepling Warrior]]s.

body.description: You served Yalahar - but you didn't seem so sure whom to believe on the way. Both Azerus and Palimuth had good reasons for their actions, and thus you followed your gut instinct in the end, even if you helped either of them. May Yalahar prosper!
body.name: Turncoat
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing mission 9 of [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]] and following some of [[Yalahari (NPC)|Yalahari's]] and some of [[Palimuth]]'s instructions.

body.description: What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
body.name: Avid Spectral Reader
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by using [[The Spatial Warp Almanac]] while inside [[Gaffir]]'s secret room accessed through the [[Cobra Bastion]].<noinclude>

The secret room can be accessed by dragging Gaffir's corpse onto the fire basin near the carpet.</noinclude>

body.description: Snow heaps and hailstorms can't keep you from where you want to go. You're perfectly equipped for any expedition into the perpetual ice and know how to keep your feet warm. If you're a woman, that's quite an accomplishment, too.
body.name: Out in the Snowstorm
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Norseman Outfits]].

body.description: You are now the public archenemy of the Shaburak, prince slayer.
body.name: Shaburak Nemesis
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 100 [[Shaburak Prince]].

body.description: You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
body.name: Dream Warrior
body.spoiler: Obtainable by receiving both addons of the [[Dream Warrior Outfits]].

body.description: You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
body.name: Top AVIN Agent
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Secret Service Quest]] for the [[AVIN]] faction.

body.description: Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
body.name: Exterminator
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Kollos Killing|Kollos Killing]] task 100 times

body.description: Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
body.name: Bearbaiting
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Bear]].

body.description: Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
body.name: Pig-Headed
body.relatedpages: [[Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest]], [[Hunting Horn]], [[Boar]], [[Rapid Boar]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Boar]].

body.description: Your stash is cleared, your bestiary completed but the grind has only just begun.
body.name: Errand Runner
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing 100 Weekly Tasks (either delivery or creature killing tasks) on the [[Task Board]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Headsman
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Axe]].

body.description: You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
body.name: Afraid of no Ghost!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Spirithunters Quest]].

body.description: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
body.name: Phantastic!
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Phant]] mount.

body.description: Sculpting Brog, the raging Titan, is your secret passion. Numerous perfect little clay statues with your name on them can be found everywhere around Tibia.
body.name: Clay to Fame
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making five [[Pretty Clay Statue]]s from [[Clay Lump]]s.

body.description: You have mastered Kuriks challenge in all possible shapes.
body.name: Master Shapeshifter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting trough teleport changed into every possible (8) forms during [[Last Creep Standing]] Event not necessarily during one try.

body.description: You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
body.history: This [[achievement]] was originally called "Pwned All Fur", but got renamed in the [[Updates/9.5|2012 Spring Patch]] because more [[Killing in the Name of... Quest|Paw and Fur Society bosses]] were introduced and a new achievement had to be implemented to cover these as well.
body.name: Pwned a Lot of Fur
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[The Snapper]], [[Hide]], [[Deathbine]], [[The Bloodtusk]], [[Shardhead]], [[Esmeralda]], [[Fleshcrawler]], [[Ribstride]], [[The Bloodweb]], [[Thul]], [[The Old Widow]], [[Flameborn]], [[Sulphur Scuttler]], [[The Many]], [[The Noxious Spawn]], [[Gorgo]], [[Stonecracker]], [[Leviathan]], [[Kerberos]] and [[Ethershreck]] in the [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]].

body.description: You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
body.name: Hive Blinder
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Antenna Blinding|Antenna Blinding]] task 100 times.

body.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
body.history: Up until the [[Winter Update 2023|Winter 2023 Update]] this achievement was unobtainable.
body.name: Warrior of the Iks
body.spoiler: Obtained by receiving both addons of the [[Ancient Aucar Outfits]].

body.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
body.name: Stuntman
body.relatedpages: [[The Mage's Tower World Change]], [[Golden Can of Oil]], [[Uniwheel (Object)]], [[Uniwheel]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Uniwheel (Object)]].

body.description: The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
body.name: Over the Moon
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the missions ''The Curse of the Full Moon'' and ''The Curse Spreads'' of the [[Grimvale Quest]].

body.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
body.name: Bane of the Hive
body.spoiler: Obtainable by collecting the second [[Insectoid Outfits]] addon.

body.description: You feel you could solve the hardest riddles within a minute or so. Plus, there's a nice boost on your spell damage. All in a little bottle. Aftereffects - feeling slightly stupid. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
body.name: Mastermind
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking ''100'' [[Mastermind Potion]]s.

body.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
body.name: Slugging Around
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Slug]].

body.description: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
body.name: Prospectre
body.spoiler: Obtainable by defeating [[The Thaian]] during the [[Feaster of Souls Quest]].

body.description: One with nature, one with wildlife. Raw and animalistic power, sharpened senses, howling on the highest cliffs and roaring in the thickest forests - that's you.
body.name: Of Wolves and Bears
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Druid Outfits]].

body.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
body.name: Si, Ariki!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by Trading for first time with NPC [[Yasir]].

body.description: You broke the jar of Horestis - fifty times. Either you know no fear or simply ignore it. Whatever the case, you are "fearless" indeed.
body.history:
The existence of this achievement was made public after the introduction of the [[Character Auctions|Char Bazar]] which lists all achievements obtained by auctioned characters.
<gallery hideaddbutton="true" position="center" style="text-align:center" captionalign="center" widths="300" heights="300" mode="nolines">
Fearless Achievement.png|''Fearless'' found in the achievement list of an auctioned character
</gallery>
body.name: Fearless
body.relatedpages: [[Horestis]], [[Ornate Canopic Jar]], [[The Mummy's Curse World Change]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by breaking 50 [[Ornate Canopic Jar]]s during [[The Mummy's Curse World Change]] event.

body.description: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
body.name: Crawling Death
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Fleshcrawler]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Fleshcrawler]].

body.description: Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
body.name: Chequered Teddy
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Panda]].

body.description: You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
body.name: Mummy's Dearest
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Southern Darama]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
body.name: Lionheart
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the [[The Order of the Lion Quest]].

body.description: You certainly have your ways when it comes to acquiring money. Many of them are pink and paved with broken fragments of porcelain.
body.name: Allowance Collector
body.spoiler: Obtainable by breaking 50 [[Piggy Bank]]s.

body.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
body.name: Unleash the Beast
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of [[Revenant Outfits]].

body.description: You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
body.name: Go with da Lava Flow
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the '''Into the Fire''' mission during the [[Hero of Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
body.name: Ancient Splendor
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Yalahar]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: To keep the witches' fire burning, you trashed a lot of the wood the bane bringers animated. Some might find your fascination for fire ... disturbing.
body.name: Fire Devil (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 100 [[Dry Piece of Wood|Dry Pieces of Wood]] on the slide of the [[Bewitched]] event. '''Note:''' you don't have to add your Dry Pieces of Wood during the event itself to gain the achievement.

body.description: Swift and silent, the jaracal now runs at your side.
body.name: Six Steps Ahead
body.spoiler: Successfully taming a [[Jaracal (Mount)|Jaracal]] using a [[Skewered Fish]].

body.description: Simple hams and bread merely make you laugh. You're the master of the extra-ordinaire, melter of cheese, fryer of bat wings and shaker of shakes. Delicious!
body.name: Culinary Master
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by cooking all the dishes in [[Hot Cuisine Quest]] '''twice'''.
'''Note for old characters:''' You need to cook the 4 new dishes introduced in the [[Updates/8.6|Summer Update 2010]] twice and cook the previous 10 again if you did that before the update in order to get this achievement.

body.description: As an avid collector you managed to complete a full set of rubber ducks during the Great Expedition and traded it for a unique noble bath tub! Given you will acquire even more ducks in the future, this is the proper way to launch them!
body.name: Rubber Ducking
body.spoiler: Exchange whole set of 16 rubber ducks with [[Proprietor Piers]] for a [[Noble Bath]]

body.description: Love ... fire! So ... shiny! Must ... buuuurrrn!
body.history: The existence of this achievement was first made public many years after its introduction, on November 18, 2017 by {{Character|Firdeso}} in a forum {{Post|38097614}}.
body.name: Pyromaniac
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 500 [[Dry Piece of Wood|Dry Pieces of Wood]] on the slide of the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
body.name: Magnetised
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming an [[Ironblight]].

body.description: You laugh at unprepared adventurers stuck in high grass or rush wood. Or maybe you actually do help them out. They call you... 'Machete'.
body.name: Nothing Can Stop Me
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Machete]], a [[Heavy Machete]] or a [[Secret Agent Tools|secret agent tool]] 100 times on [[Jungle Grass]] or [[Wild Growth]]. '''Note:''' The south of [[Port Hope]] is filled with Jungle Grass.

body.description: You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
body.name: Inquisition's Hand
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Grave Danger Quest]].

body.description: You're in the front line when it comes to saving your world or taking part in social events. Whether you do it noticed or unnoticed by the people, your world can rely on you to dutifully do your part to make it a better place for everyone.
body.history: This achievement was removed from the game with the [[Updates/9.4|Winter Update 2011]] due to a bug which allowed players to obtain it without any effort, as stated by CM [[Mirade]] on {{Post|31772204}}.
body.name: Notorious Worldsaver
body.spoiler: Participate in the [[A Piece of Cake]], [[Annual Autumn Vintage]], [[Bewitched]], [[Demon's Lullaby]], [[Rise of Devovorga]], [[The Colours of Magic]], and [[The Lightbearer]] [[World Quests]].

body.description: You like your cake soft, with fruity bits and a nice sugar icing. And you prefer to make them by yourself. Have you ever considered opening a bakery? You must be really good by now!
body.name: With a Cherry on Top
body.spoiler: Obtainable by decorating 20 [[Cake]]s with fruits.

body.description: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
body.name: Beyonder
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Feaster of Souls Quest]].

body.description: Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
body.name: Snowbunny
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by changing 10.000 tiles of [[Snow]] into tiles of [[Snow (Footsteps)]]
({{Message|type=look|Someone must have walked here recently}}).

body.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
body.name: Ending the Horror
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the mission [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#A Retched Beginning|A Retched Beginning]] during the [[Roshamuul Quest]].

body.description: You travelled the world for an almost meaningless prayer - but at least you don't have to do that again and can get a new blessed stake in the blink of an eye.
body.name: Blessed!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Blessed Stake Quest]]. '''Note:''' you don't need to obtain a second blessed wooden stake from Chondur: just speak with him about it until he says "(...) Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>".

body.description: Thick, red - shaken, not stirred - and with a straw in it: that's the way you prefer your demon blood. Served with an onion ring, the subtle metallic aftertaste is almost not noticeable. Beneficial effects on health or mana are welcome.
body.name: Demonic Barkeeper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by shaking 250 [[Flask of Demonic Blood]].

body.description: Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
body.name: Blacknailed
body.relatedpages: [[The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest]], [[Nail Case]], [[Gravedigger]], [[The Hellgrip]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Gravedigger]].

body.description: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
body.name: Drama in Darama
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the '''An Ancient Feud''' mission of the [[Grimvale Quest]].

body.description: You love the winter. Fully equipped with scarf and gloves, you like to have fun outside while building lots of snowmen with your friends. Snowball fight, anyone?
body.history: Until the Christmas in 2022, it was only possible to get this achievement by using brand new [[Snowman Package]]s, and the achievement was harder/more expensive to obtain. Due to ''a fix for a reported bug'' that was released sometime in 2022, it became possible to get the achievement by wrapping/unwrapping the same Kit several times.
body.name: The Snowman
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by opening 100 [[Snowman Package]]s or [[Furniture Kit]]s containing Snowmen.
Note: You can wrap/unwrap the same Kit 100 times to get the achievement.

body.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
body.history: Although the mount was implemented on [[Updates/10.90|Update 10.90]], this achievement was implemented over 2 years later with [[Updates/11.86|Update 11.86]].
body.name: Running the Rift
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Mysterious Scroll]] and receiving the [[Rift Runner]] mount.

body.description: You're not afraid to show your colours in the heat of battle. Enemies fear your lethal lance and impenetrable armor. The list of the wars you've won is impressive. Hail and kill!
body.name: Master of War
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Warmaster Outfits]].

body.description: You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons.
body.name: Explorer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the second explorer's mission, ''The Spectral Dress'', in [[The Explorer Society Quest]].

body.description: Pray it never finds its way back to its original stable with you still riding.
body.name: Hell Rider

body.description: Up and down and up and down... and then the big looping! Wait - they don't build loopings in Kazordoon. But ore wagon rides are still fun!
body.name: Rollercoaster
body.spoiler: Obtainable by traveling by [[Ore Wagon|ore wagon]] 100 times.

body.description: Psss psss psss ...
body.name: Purrfectly Addicted
body.spoiler: Obtained after using [[Catnip]] 100 times

body.description: You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slayed the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team!
body.name: Lord of the Elements (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Elemental Spheres Quest]].

body.description: Your expertise in weaponry reaches new heights.
body.name: A Well-Honed Arsenal
body.relatedpages: [[Arsenal of War]], [[The First of Many]], [[The Forbidden Build]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by achieving Mastery in [[Weapon Proficiency]] on 10 different weapons.

body.description: Did someone call a doctor? You delivered 100 medicine bags to Ottokar of the Venore poor house in times of dire need, well done!
body.name: Doctor! Doctor!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by delivering 100 [[Medicine Pouch]]es to [[Ottokar]] in Venore Poor House.

body.description: You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons.
body.name: Follower of Palimuth
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing mission 9 of [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]] when you follow all of [[Palimuth]]'s instructions. '''Note:''' If you finish one or some missions by following [[Yalahari (NPC)]]'s instructions you will get the [[Achievements#Turncoat|Turncoat]] achievement instead.

body.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
body.name: Hive Fighter
body.spoiler: Obtainable after earning 300 War Exp in [[War Against the Hive Quest]].

body.description: You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns.
body.name: Minstrel
body.spoiler: Obtainable by playing [[Musical Instruments]] 500 times and by solving the instruments puzzle in [[Vashresamun]]'s antechamber.

body.description: Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it.
body.name: Lucid Dreamer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the Mission 4 of [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]].

body.description: You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
body.name: Gem Cutter
body.spoiler: Obtainable during [[Liquid Black Quest#Heart_of_the_Sea|Liquid Black Quest]] for cutting your first {{Ilink|The Heart of the Sea}} [[Heart of the Sea]].

body.description: You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles.
body.name: Scrapper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Barbarian Arena Quest]] in the Scrapper difficulty.

body.description: You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
body.name: Golem in the Gears
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].

body.description: That has been a close call ...
body.name: Razor's Edge
body.spoiler: Defeat [[The Gravedigger]] while having 18, 19, or 20 stacks. Keep in mind that you die instantly when getting hit by the waves with 20 stacks.

body.description: With edged blade and fully equipped in a sturdy full plate armor, you charge at your enemies with both strength and valour. There's always a maiden to save and a dragon to slay for you.
body.name: In Shining Armor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Knight Outfits]].

body.description: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
body.name: Beak Doctor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Afflicted Outfits]].

body.description: Who's the milkman? You are!
body.name: The Milkman
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the daily task {{Spoiler Section|An Uneasy Alliance Quest|Task 1 - Milk Delivery}}.

body.description: You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
body.name: Merry Adventures
body.relatedpages: [[Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest]].

body.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
body.name: Spectral Traveller
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing 5 journeys in [[A Pirate's Death to Me]].

body.description: Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
body.name: Battle Mage
body.spoiler: Obtainable by receiving the [[Battle Mage Outfits]].

body.description: That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
body.name: Someone's Bored
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing a [[Giant Spider (Wyda)|fake giant spider]].

body.description: You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
body.name: A Study in Scarlett
body.spoiler: Obtainable by defeating [[Scarlett Etzel]]

body.description: The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
body.name: One Less
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[The Many]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[The Many]].

body.description: The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
body.name: Hive Infiltrator
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Kollos Killing|Kollos Killing]] task 50 times.

body.description: If someone lost a random thing in a random place, you're probably a good person to ask and go find it, even if you don't know what and where.
body.name: Backpack Tourist
body.relatedpages: [[Sam]], [[Old and Used Backpack]], [[Dwarven Armor]], [[Sam's Old Backpack Quest]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by giving back to Sam his old backpack ([[Sam's Old Backpack Quest]]).

body.description: Somebody will be terribly sad about your actions! Imagine how much time it took to build all those castles ....
body.name: Castle Crasher
body.spoiler: Obtainable by stepping on 10 [[Sand Castle]]s on [[Aragonia]].

body.description: You helped bringing Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness and Lucky the Wonder Dog to life - and will probably dream of them tonight, since you memorised your lines perfectly. What a .. special piece of.. screenplay.
body.name: Amateur Actor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing Mission 4 of [[The Thieves Guild Quest]].

body.description: The Combined Magical Winterberry Society hereby honours continued selfless dedication and extraordinary efforts in the Annual Autumn Vintage.
body.name: Berry Picker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by contributing for 3 years in the [[Annual Autumn Vintage]] world event.

body.description: You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Little Adventure
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 10 easy monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
body.name: Reason to Celebrate
body.spoiler: Obtained by attaining the full version of the [[Festive Outfits]].

body.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your ripptor.
body.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Ripptor]] mount.

body.description: You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
body.name: His Days are Counted
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using the lava pump in the room reached after defeating [[The Count Of The Core]] in the [[Dangerous Depths Quest]].

body.description: Scythe swung over your shoulder, sun burning down on your back - you are a farmer at heart and love working in the fields. Or then again maybe you just create fancy crop circles to scare your fellow men.
body.name: Happy Farmer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by cutting down 200 [[wheat]] with a [[Scythe]] or [[Squeezing Gear of Girlpower]].

body.description: You've touched all thrones of the Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever.
body.name: Ruthless
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Pits of Inferno Quest]].

body.description: Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
body.name: Friend of Elves
body.relatedpages: [[Golden Fir Cone]], [[Music Box]], [[White Deer]], [[Enraged White Deer]], [[Kingly Deer]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming an [[Enraged White Deer]].

body.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
body.name: Death Song
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 300 [[Deepling Spellsinger]]s.

body.description: Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
body.name: Silent Pet
body.spoiler: Obtained by catching a [[Small Fish]] with an [[Empty Goldfish Bowl]].

body.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
body.name: The Gates of Hell
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Kerberos]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Kerberos]].

body.description: With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
body.name: Slimer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Slime Gobbler]] on Slime Fungus around 500 times.

body.description: You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
body.name: Combo Master
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing at least 10 consecutive Combinatorics tasks perfectly in the [[Oramond Quest]].

body.description: You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
body.name: Millennial Falcon
body.spoiler: Obtained by defeating [[Grand Master Oberon]] during [[The Secret Library Quest]].

body.description: Surely, this will prove useful in the future... right?
body.history: This achievement was first discovered by {{Character|Alpha Charly}}, who publicly mentioned it on {{Post|39540522|September 05, 2025}} without revealing any details on how to obtain it.
body.name: The Forbidden Build
body.relatedpages: [[The First of Many]], [[A Well-Honed Arsenal]], [[Arsenal of War]]
body.spoiler:
Obtained by earning Mastery with certain 'useless' weapons.
Confirmed weapons are the following: * {{Ilink|Club of the Fury}} [[Club of the Fury]] * {{Ilink|Glooth Blade}} [[Glooth Blade]] * {{Ilink|Glutton's Mace}} [[Glutton's Mace]] * {{Ilink|Glooth Club}} [[Glooth Club]] * {{Ilink|Ice Rapier}} [[Ice Rapier]] * {{Ilink|Incredible Mumpiz Slayer}} [[Incredible Mumpiz Slayer]] * {{Ilink|Musician's Bow}} [[Musician's Bow]] * {{Ilink|Ornate Carving Rod}} [[Ornate Carving Rod]] * {{Ilink|Ornate Mayhem Wand}} [[Ornate Mayhem Wand]] * {{Ilink|Pointed Rabbitslayer}} [[Pointed Rabbitslayer]] * {{Ilink|Small Stone}} [[Small Stone]] * {{Ilink|Snowball}} [[Snowball]]

body.description: You and your shovel - a match made in heaven. Or hell, for that matter. Somewhere down below in any case. You're magically attracted by stone piles and love to open them up and see where those holes lead you. Good biceps as well.
body.name: The Undertaker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening 500 [[Loose Stone Pile]]s or [[Large Hole]]s.

body.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
body.name: Rootless Behaviour
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Deathbine]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Deathbine]].

body.description: You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
body.name: Mind the Step!
body.relatedpages: [[The Orb of Darkness Eternal]], [[Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest]], [[Guardian of the Deep Seas]], [[Quara]], [[Stone Snake Shrine]], [[Mind Stone]]
body.spoiler: Received when obtaining [[The Orb of Darkness Eternal]] in [[Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Executioner
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Chopper]].

body.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
body.name: Gnome Little Helper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by advancing to rank I in the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
body.name: Hoard of the Dragon
body.relatedpages: [[The Great Dragon Hunt Quest]], [[Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs]]
body.spoiler: Complete [[The Great Dragon Hunt Quest]] 10 times.

body.description: You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
body.name: Witches Lil' Helper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by throwing one ingredient into the witches cauldron during the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
body.name: Dream Catcher (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[The Nightmare Beast]] and then reporting to [[Undal]] or [[Vanys]].

body.description: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
body.name: Beaver Away
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Giant Beaver]].

body.description: Under the sea - might not be your natural living space, but you're feeling quite comfortable on the ocean floor. Quara don't scare you anymore and sometimes you sleep with your helmet of the deep still equipped.
body.name: Deep Sea Diver
body.spoiler: Obtainable by walking 1,000,000 steps [[underwater]]. Confirmed working tiles are [[Ocean Floor]], underwater [[Marble Floor (Yielothax Dimension)|‎Marble Floor]] and underwater [[Sandstone Floor]]. Lava crack tiles in the [[Sea Serpent Area]] are not counted, as those are also used on land. Tip: use a [[Coconut Shrimp Bake]] to increase your underwater walking speed before attempting this achievement.

body.description: You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
body.name: Desert Fisher
body.spoiler: Obtainable for fishing a Sandfish during [[River Runs Deep Mini World Change]].

body.description: The forbidden knowledge of aeons was never meant to invade this world. You silenced its voice before it could be made heard.
body.name: Slayer of Teneshpar
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Teneshpar]] during [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]] or [[Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change]].

body.description: Many creatures of the deep have lost their lives by your hand. Three hundred have entered the depths of eternity. You should probably fear the revenge of the Eyes of the Deep.
body.name: Invader of the Deep
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 300 [[Deepling Scout]]s.

body.description: People with sharp canine teeth better beware of you, especially at nighttime, or they might find a stake between their ribs. You're a merciless vampire hunter and have gathered numerous tokens as proof.
body.name: Razing!
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the rank of "''Razing!''" in the [[Vampire_Hunter_Quest#Ranks_and_Rewards|Vampire Hunter Quest]] by handing in 100 [[Vampire Lord Token]]s.

body.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
body.name: Royalty of Hazard
body.spoiler: Obtained by defeating [[The Primal Menace]] at hazard level 11.

body.description: You don't consider yourself too good to do the dirty work while someone else might win the laurels for killing Devovorga. They couldn't do it without you!
body.name: Teamplayer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by entering one of sub-boss spawns during the [[Rise of Devovorga]] Quest.

body.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
body.name: Sharp Dressed
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Formal Dress Outfits]].

body.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
body.name: Snake Charmer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest]].

body.description: You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
body.history: In the past (before 2016) unsuccessful skinning of [[Bonebeast]]s counted as well, but this is not the case anymore.
body.name: Skin-Deep
body.spoiler: Obtainable by successfully [[skinning]] 500 monsters.

body.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
body.name: True Dedication
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting full [[Demon Outfits]].

body.description: When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
body.name: Follower of Azerus
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing mission 9 [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]] when you follow all of [[Yalahari (NPC)]]'s instructions. '''Note:''' If you finish one or some missions by following [[Palimuth]]'s instructions you will get the [[Achievements#Turncoat|Turncoat]] achievement instead.

body.description: Your world is lucky to have you! You don't hesitate to jump in and help when brave heroes are called to save the world.
body.name: I Did My Part
body.relatedpages: [[World Quests]], [[Rise of Devovorga]], [[Lightbearer Event]], [[Bewitched]], [[A Piece of Cake]], [[The Colours of Magic]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by taking part in a world quest. [[Rise of Devovorga]]: by entering portal to any sub-boss room. [[Lightbearer]]: by using the [[statue of Fafnar]] in the reward room. [[Bewitched]]: by adding an ingredient or wood to the cauldron. [[A Piece of Cake]]: by stepping on a spot where cake was already eaten. [[The Colours of Magic]]: by joining a wizard.

body.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
body.name: The Picky Pig
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Digging mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
body.name: Spolium Profundis
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the full [[Deepling Outfits]].

body.description: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
body.name: Pied Piper
body.spoiler:
Obtained by greeting [[Eustacio]] after getting 5000 points with him during the [[A Pirate's Tail Quest]].

The fastest way to do that is to hunt [[Pirats]] under [[Rascacoon]] or on [[The Wreckoning]] after getting access to these places.

body.description: You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
body.name: Pwned All Fur
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing all bosses in the [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]].

body.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
body.name: The Ogre Steppe
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Krailos]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You're not sure what it is, but you feel drawn to royalty. Your knees are always a bit grazed from crawling around in front of thrones and you love hanging out in castles. Maybe you should consider applying as a guard?
body.name: King Tibianus Fan
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Isle of Evil Quest]].

body.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
body.name: Some Like It Hot
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the [[Too Hot to Handle Quest]].

body.description: Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect and trade options with the green djinns.
body.name: Efreet Ally
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Djinn War - Efreet Faction]].

body.description: Travelling with the dwarven steamboats through the underground rivers is your preferred way of crossing the lands. No pesky seagulls, and good beer on board!
body.name: Steampunked
body.spoiler: Obtainable by traveling by [[Steamship]] 100 times. The cheapest option is to travel between Kazordoon and Cormaya (160gp, or 150gp if you’ve completed [[The Postman Missions Quest]]) until you gain the achievement.

body.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
body.name: Supplier
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Dissolved Chitin|Dissolved Chitin]] task 50 times.

body.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
body.history: Although the mount was implemented on [[Updates/11.50|Update 11.50]], this achievement was only implemented on [[Updates/11.53|Update 11.53]].
body.name: Up the Molehill
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Mole]].

body.description: Muahahaha it's a... mutated pumpkin! After helping to take it down - you DID help, didn't you? - you claimed your reward and got a more or less weird present. Happy Halloween!
body.name: Mutated Presents
body.spoiler: Obtainable by skinning [[The Mutated Pumpkin]]'s dead body.

body.description: You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
body.name: Truth Be Told
body.spoiler: Obtainable by telling truth to [[Jack]] after finishing [[Jack to the Future Quest]].

body.description: What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
body.name: Out of the Stone Age
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming an [[Undead Cavebear]].

body.description: You do not fear nightmares, you travel in them - facing countless horrors and fighting the fate they're about to bring. Few believe the dark prophecies you bring back from those dreams, but those who do fight alongside you as Nightmare Knights.
body.name: Nightmare Walker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Nightmare Outfits]]

body.description: Stones have always fascinated you. So has the chance of finding something really precious inside one of them. Statistically you should've discovered a few nice treasures by now. But then again, most statistics are overriden by Mother Disfortune.
body.name: Petrologist
body.spoiler: Using pick on 100 [[Shiny Stone|Shiny stones]].

body.description: Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
body.name: Spin-Off
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Wailing Widow]].

body.description: Yay! Finders keepers, losers weepers! Who cares where all that stuff came from and if you had to crawl through garbage piles to get it? It's FREE!
body.name: Free Items!
body.spoiler: Obtainable after getting 50 items from [[Crate (Usable)|Crate]]s.

body.description: You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
body.name: Guard Killer
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Kollos Killing|Kollos Killing]] task 10 times

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Berserker
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Hammer]].

body.description: Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
body.name: Icy Glare
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Half-Frozen Ursagrodon]].

body.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
body.name: Steppe Elegance
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the [[Antelope]] mount.

body.description: Your home is your castle - and the furniture in it is just as important. Your friends ask for your advice when decorating their houses and your probably own every statue, rack and bed there is.
body.name: Interior Decorator
body.spoiler:
Since [[Updates/10.92|April 2016 (Update 10.92)]], this achievement is obtained by making 1000 purchases of [[Furniture Kit]]s. Note that you’ll have to make 1000 individual furniture kit purchases — making 10 purchases of 100 furniture kits each, for example, would only count as 10 purchases. '''Hint:''' The cheapest way to do this is to buy 1000 [[Trough]]s (7 [[gp]] each).
Before [[Updates/10.92|April 2016]], you had to use 1000 [[Furniture Package]]s to obtain this achievement.

body.description: You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
body.name: Trail of the Ape God
body.relatedpages: [[Mini World Changes]], [[Stampede Mini World Change|Stampede]], [[Terrified Elephant]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 5 [[Terrified Elephant]]s during the [[Stampede Mini World Change]].

body.description: You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
body.name: Lacewing Catcher
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Lacewing Moth]].

body.description: You found and took a sip from the Fountain of Life. Thought it didn't grant you eternal life, you feel changed and somehow at peace.
body.name: Fountain of Life
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking from the [[fountain]] of life in [[pits of inferno]]'s entrance {{Mapper Coords|128.38|126.65|11|1|text=here}}.

body.description: You have cheered up a bunch of demon babies and returned them to their mother. Don't bother the burn marks, don't bother the strains of grey hair, don't bother the nights you wake up screaming. It was worth it ... probably ... somehow.
body.name: Nanny from Hell
body.spoiler: Obtainable by successfully taking care of a [[Demon Infant]] during the [[Demon's Lullaby]] [[event]] for 5 years.

body.description: You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
body.name: Hickup
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Disrupt The Hives Digestion|Disrupt The Hives Digestion]] task 10 times.

body.description: Joran and Yvette have brought the colours back to the world, and you have freed it from the monsters of this story. The world of books is now yours.
body.name: Illuminator
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Illuminator Outfits]].

body.description: The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
body.name: Choking on Her Venom
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[The Old Widow]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[The Old Widow]].

body.description: Weehee! Whack those worms! You sure know how to handle a big hammer.
body.name: Worm Whacker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing mission 4 of the [[Isle of Evil Quest]].

body.description: Home is where your current favourite hunting ground is, and though you might hold certain places more dear than others you never feel attached enough to really stay in one city for long. Pack all your stuff - it's time to move on again.
body.name: Nomad Soul
body.spoiler: Obtainable by becoming a citizen of [[Ab'Dendriel]], [[Ankrahmun]], [[Carlin]], [[Darashia]], [[Edron]], [[Farmine]], [[Kazordoon]], [[Liberty Bay]], [[Port Hope]], [[Svargrond]], [[Thais]], [[Venore]], and [[Yalahar]].

body.description: It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
body.name: Knock on Wood
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Tin Lizzard (Object)]].

body.description: You don't need much to sleep comfortably. A pile of straw and a roof over your head - with the latter being completely optional - is quite enough to relax. You don't even mind the rats nibbling on your toes.
body.name: Modest Guest
body.spoiler: Obtainable by sleeping on a [[Straw Mat]] 100 times.

body.description: Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
body.name: Fairy Teasing
body.spoiler:
Use a total of 100 {{Ilink|Small Plant House (Usable)}} [[Small Plant House (Usable)|usable Small Plant Houses]] ({{Server Message|This is my house! Back off!}}) and {{Ilink|Dancing Fairy (Object)}} [[Dancing Fairy (Object)|Dancing Fairies]] ({{Server Message|Doooon't touch me! *puff*}}).

Unlike the Dancing Fairies, you can use the Small Plant Houses uninterruptedly, which is the faster way of getting this achievement. Just make sure you're trying on one of the two [[Small Plant House (Usable)|versions]] of it that can really be used, since most of them can't. One possibility is to use the Small Plant House near NPC [[Tooth Fairy]] in Ab’Dendriel.

body.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
body.name: Howly Silence
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Hemming]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[Hemming]].

body.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
body.name: The Rule of Raccool
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Draccoon Herald Outfits]].

body.description: The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
body.name: Death in the Depths
body.spoiler: Obtained by destroying all 3 lava pumps after defeating the bosses of [[Warzone 4]], [[Warzone 5]] and [[Warzone 6]].

body.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
body.name: Dream Wright
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#Mend_What.27s_Broken|Mend What's Broken]] task of the [[Roshamuul Quest]] 34 times (freeing 102 [[Shimmying Butterfly|Shimmying Butterflies]]).

body.description: You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
body.name: Tied the Knot
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finding all spell words during the Haunted House mission of [[The Dream Courts Quest]].

body.description: It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
body.history: This achievement used to be of grade 1 and give 3 points, but the backlash [[CipSoft]] faced for implementing an achievement involving real-life expenditures urged them to change it on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3322|September 15, 2015}}, and since then it no longer gives achievement points and cannot be earned anymore. Players who had earned it prior to CipSoft's rectification can select to display it on their character page, though.
body.name: The More the Merrier
body.spoiler: Used to be obtainable by logging into the game after earning the full [[Recruiter Outfits]].

body.description: It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
body.name: Personal Nightmare
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Shock Head]].

body.description: You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
body.name: Pimple
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Pore Stuffing|Pore Stuffing]] task 50 times.

body.description: This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
body.name: Fried Shrimp
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Crustacea Gigantica]].

body.description: You and your stuffed furry friends are inseparable, and you're not ashamed to take them to bed with you - who knows when you will wake up in the middle of the night in dire need of a cuddle?
body.name: I Need a Hug
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Panda Teddy]], [[Stuffed Dragon]], [[Baby Seal Doll]] and [[Santa Doll]] one time each.

body.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
body.name: Enter zze Draken!
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Paiz the Pauperizer]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Paiz the Pauperizer]].

body.description: Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
body.name: Sculptor Apprentice
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by delivering a [[Small Tortoise]], a [[Bat (Item)]], a [[Scorpion (Item)]], a [[Scared Frog]], and a [[Calamary (Item)]] to [[Alyxo]].

Note: You can only do this after finishing the {{Spoiler Section|Kilmaresh Quest|Fafnar's Wrath}}.

body.description: You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
body.name: Whistle-Blower
body.relatedpages: [[Mini World Changes]], [[Lumberjack Mini World Change|Lumberjack]], [[Chip]], [[Queen Eloise]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by telling [[Queen Eloise]] about [[Chip]] during [[Lumberjack Mini World Change]].

body.description: You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
body.name: Master Debater
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting all books of [[The Grand Master of Verbal Debate]] and by defeating [[Grand Master Oberon]] during [[The Secret Library Quest]].

body.description: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
body.name: Engine Driver
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Gloothomotive]] mount.

body.description: Blind hatred took physical form, violently rebelling against the injustice it was born into. You were not able to bring justice - but at least temporary peace.
body.name: Slayer of Phrodomo
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Phrodomo]] during [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]] or [[Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change]].

body.description: You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Contender
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 10 medium monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
body.name: Lizard Kingdom
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Zao]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
body.name: Do a Barrel Roll!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by receiving a [[Blue Rolling Barrel]], [[Green Rolling Barrel]] or a [[Red Rolling Barrel]]. Note: You can obtain the 3 different Barrels, but there is only one achievement given for the first one you chose.

body.description: Dragon dreams are golden.
body.name: Wayfarer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by doing 9th mission of the [[Wrath of the Emperor Quest]].

body.description: You defend Yalahar with brute force and are ready to lead it into a glorious battle, if necessary. Thanks to you, Yalahar will be powerful enough to stand up against any enemy.
body.name: Yalahari of Power
body.spoiler: Obtainable by receiving the evil side addon from [[Palimuth]] by turning in a [[Vampiric Crest]] after having completed the [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

body.description: Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
body.name: Heartburn
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Disrupt The Hives Digestion|Disrupt The Hives Digestion]] task 50 times

body.description: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
body.name: Falconer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the full [[Falconer Outfits]].

body.description: You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.
body.name: Taskaholic

body.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
body.name: Twisted Dreams
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Roshamuul]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your katar into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Redeemer
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Katar]].

body.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
body.name: Rathleton Citizen
body.spoiler: Obtained by reaching the rank of '''Citizen''' in the [[Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
body.name: Strangest Thing
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Mutated Abomination]] mount.

body.description: You're a beggar, homeless, wearing filthy and ragged clothes. But that doesn't mean you have to beg anyone for stuff - and you still kept your pride. Fine feathers do not necessarily make fine birds - what's under them is more important.
body.name: Life on the Streets
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Beggar Outfit]].
