body.description: You're one of the brave heroes to face and defeat the mysterious demon oak and all the critters it threw in your face. Wielding your blessed axe no tree dares stand in your way - demonic or not.
body.name: Herbicide
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing [[The Demon Oak Quest]].

body.description: Hidden treasures below the sand dunes of the desert - you have a nose for finding them and you know where to dig. They might not make you filthy rich, but they're shiny and pretty anyhow.
body.name: Gold Digger
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by digging up 100 [[Scarab Coin|scarab coin]]s in the desert. There's a chance to dig up a scarab coin or [[Scarab]] in Ankrahmun desert.
The tiles where you can dig can be seen in the Cyclopedia map as light grey squares, as highlighted in the image below, but these aren't visible on the minimap or on TibiaWiki's mapper. They can be found all around the desert, but mostly around [[Ankrahmun Tombs|tombs]] entrances and the city gates. There is a 60 minute cooldown on each digging square.
[[File:Scarab Digging Tiles.png]]

{{Seealso|Scarab Coin/Statistics}}

body.description: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
body.name: Citizen of Issavi
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Citizen of Issavi Outfits]].

body.description: You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Master Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 100 hard monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
body.name: Sun and Sea
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the first 5 missions of [[Kilmaresh Quest]].

body.description: You can easily be found by anyone if they just follow the cookie crumb trail. And for you, true love means to give away your last cookie.
body.name: Cookie Monster
body.spoiler: Obtainable by baking [[Cookie]]s 20 times.

body.description: You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
body.name: Bibby's Bloodbath
body.relatedpages: [[Mini World Changes]], [[Warpath Mini World Change|Warpath]], [[Bibby Bloodbath]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[Bibby Bloodbath]].

body.description: You love getting your hands wet and dirty - and covered with clay. Your perfect sculpture of Brog, the raging Titan is your true masterpiece.
body.name: Clay Fighter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making a [[Pretty Clay Statue]] from a [[Clay Lump]].

body.description: One of the Lightbearers. One of those who helped to keep the basins burning and worked together against the darkness. The demonic whispers behind the thin veil between the worlds - they were silenced again thanks to your help.
body.name: Keeper of the Flame
body.spoiler: Obtained by participating in the [[Lightbearer Event]] by lighting at least one [[Lightbringer's Basin]].

body.description: You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
body.name: Ogre Chef
body.spoiler: Complete the ''The Chieftain's Menu'' mission of the [[Krailos Quest]] 3 times.

body.description: In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
body.name: Dazzler
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Antenna Blinding|Antenna Blinding]] task 50 times.

body.description: You have helped to keep the witches fire burning. Just watch your fingers, it's hot!
body.name: Fire Lighter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using one [[Dry Piece of Wood]] on the slide during the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours
body.name: Mutagenius
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the mutagen task of [[The Cradle of Monsters Quest]] while having all 16 mutagens in the same colour.

body.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
body.name: Funghitastic
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Soil Guardian Outfits]].

body.description: You have an eye for suspicious places and love to read other people's diaries, especially those with vampire stories in it. You're also a dedicated token collector and explorer. Respect!
body.name: Castlemania
body.relatedpages: [[Julius' Map]], [[Vampire Lord Token]], [[Blood Skull]], [[Blood Goblet]], [[Old Piece of Paper]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Blood Brothers Quest]], marking all 8 spots on Julius' Map, finishing the [[Vampire Hunter Quest]], picking up the [[Blood Skull]], [[Blood Goblet]] and all missing diary pages (6 pieces). '''Note:''' You can redo your map by saying ''map'', then ''yes'' to Julius.

body.description: You have bravely stepped onto the cake isle. Is there any more beautiful, tasty place to be in the whole world?
body.name: Cake Conqueror
body.spoiler: Obtainable during [[A Piece of Cake]] by stepping on a spot where cake was already eaten.

body.description: You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
body.name: Duked It Out
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using the lava pump in the room reached after defeating [[The Duke Of The Depths]] in the [[Dangerous Depths Quest]].

body.description: Christmas is your favourite time of the year, and boy, do you love presents. Buy some nice things for your friends, hide them away until - well, until you decide to actually unwrap them rather yourself.
body.name: Santa's Li'l Helper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening 25 [[Christmas Bundle]]s (any color).

body.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
body.name: Crystal Clear
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the [[Crystal Warlord Outfits]].

body.description: You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
body.name: Scourge of Death
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing 50 journeys in [[A Pirate's Death to Me]].

body.description: Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
body.name: Realms of Dreams
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Feyrist (Peninsula)|Feyrist]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Walking past an echo is no option. You're already addicted.
body.name: Echo Walker
body.spoiler: Obtained after triggering 500 [[Echo Raid]]s.

body.description: You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
body.name: Chitin Bane
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Dissolved Chitin|Dissolved Chitin]] task 100 times.

body.description: You found a hundred beautiful pearls in large sea shells. By now that necklace should be finished - and hopefully you didn't get your fingers squeezed too often during the process.
body.name: Shell Seeker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finding 100 [[Giant Shimmering Pearl]]s of any colour out of [[Large Seashell (Closed)|closed large seashell]]s.

body.description: You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
body.name: Back into the Abyss
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Thul]].

body.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
body.name: Substitute Tinker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Golem Repair mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
body.name: Suppressor
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Pore Stuffing|Pore Stuffing]] task 100 times.

body.description: You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
body.name: Blood-Red Snapper
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[The Snapper]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[The Snapper]].

body.description: Smart you indeed. The gods almost gave up hope that anyone would ever figure THAT one out. They smile on you proudly now.
body.history:
* In 2024, [[Rejana]] [https://www.tibia.com/forum/?action=thread&postid=39469348#post39469348 confirmed] the achievement is not bugged.
* In February 2025, during the [[Monk Vocation Update]] [[Test Server]], [[CipSoft]] provided characters with certain levels and many [[quests]] completed for players to test around. These characters had this [[achievement]] unlocked, so it was possible for players to find out its name, description, and grade.
body.name: Smart Thinking

body.description: You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
body.name: Preservationist
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Ice Flower Seeds]] on a fully grown plant in a [[Flower Pot]].

body.description: Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
body.name: Way of the Shaman
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Shaman Outfits]].

body.description: Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
body.name: Glooth Punk
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Oramond]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
body.name: Vortex Tamer
body.spoiler:
Obtained by taming the following:
* {{Ilink|Sparkion}} a [[Sparkion]]  by using a [[Vibrant Egg]] {{Ilink|Vibrant Egg}},
* {{Ilink|Neon Sparkid}} a [[Neon Sparkid]] , by using a [[Crackling Egg]] {{Ilink|Crackling Egg}},
* {{Ilink|Vortexion}} a [[Vortexion]] by using a [[Menacing Egg]] {{Ilink|Menacing Egg}}.

This is arguably the most expensive [[Achievement]] in [[Tibia]], as purchasing all three Eggs can easily exceed a total cost of 2,500,000,000{{GP}}.

body.description: Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed.
body.name: Poet Laureate
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing mission 3 of [[Kissing a Pig Quest]], finding the [[Ancient Tombs (Book)|poem about the ancient tombs]] at the [[Great Pyramid]] in Ankrahmun, and then entering the first "endless" door of [[Dipthrah]]'s chambers ([[Mountain Tomb]]).

body.description: Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
body.name: Safely Stored Away
body.spoiler: Obtainable by steping on tile next to depot 1000 times.

body.description: The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
body.name: Planter
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Pore Stuffing|Pore Stuffing]] task 10 times.

body.description: You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails.
body.name: Beach Tamer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing [[The Mermaid Marina Quest]].

body.description: You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
body.name: Forbidden Fruit (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtained by eating a [[Forbidden Fruit]].

body.description: You have defeated the Snake God's incarnations and, with a final powerful swing of the snake sceptre, cut off his life force supply. The story of power, deceit and corruption has come to an end - or... not?
body.name: Godslayer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Replica of the Sceptre]] on [[Mutated Zalamon]]'s corpse during the 11th mission of [[Wrath of the Emperor Quest]].

body.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
body.name: Champion of Summer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 20 bosses at the [[Dream Scar]] as part of [[The Dream Courts Quest]] when fighting for the Summer Dreamelves.

body.description: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
body.name: Woodcarver
body.relatedpages: [[The Order of the Lion Quest]], [[Kesar the Younger]], [[Bounac]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by defeating [[Megasylvan Yselda]] during the [[Adventures of Galthen Quest]].

body.description: Oh my god, it's a paaaaaaaaaaaarty! You're always in for fun, friends and booze and love being the center of attention. There's endless reasons to celebrate! Woohoo!
body.name: Party Animal
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Party Trumpet]] or [[Party Hat]] 200 times. '''Note:''' A Party Hat is recommended since there is absolutely no delay in using it multiple times.

body.description: Life can be so easy with the right cake at the right time - and you mastered baking many different ones, so you should be prepared for almost everything life decides to throw at you.
body.name: Piece of Cake
body.spoiler: Obtainable by baking one [[Chocolate Cake]] and one [[Decorated Cake]].

body.description: You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
body.name: Buried the Baron
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using the lava pump in the room reached after defeating [[The Baron From Below]] in the [[Dangerous Depths Quest]].

body.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
body.name: Traditionalist
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by receiving both addons of the [[Orcsoberfest Garb Outfits]].<noinclude>
You need to defeat [[King Chuck]] at least once in 6 different editions of the [[Orcsoberfest]] in order to get all parts of the traditional [[Orcsoberfest Garb Outfits]]. Additionally, on each event you'll get only one part of the [[Traditional Set]]. However, the items are '''not''' needed for the outfit.
*{{Ilink|Lederhosen}} [[Lederhosen]] - First time
*{{Ilink|Traditional Shirt}} [[Traditional Shirt]] - Second time
*{{Ilink|Traditional Neckerchief}} [[Traditional Neckerchief]] - Third time
*{{Ilink|Traditional Stein}} [[Traditional Stein]] - Fourth time
*{{Ilink|Traditional Gamsbart Hat}} [[Traditional Gamsbart Hat]] - Fifth time
*{{Ilink|Traditional Leather Shoes}} [[Traditional Leather Shoes]] - Sixth time</noinclude>

body.description: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
body.name: Mainstreet Nightmare
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the full [[Poltergeist Outfits]].

body.description: You never can tell, who's boss here.
body.history: * Was first acquired by {{Character|Alpha Charlyne}} on June 8, 2025.
body.name: Alpha Rider
body.spoiler: Obtained by using a [[Demon in a Golden Box]] and taming an [[Alpha Demonosaur]].

body.description: Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
body.name: Loyal Lad
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Donkey]].

body.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
body.name: Rathleton Inhabitant
body.spoiler: Obtained by reaching the rank of '''Inhabitant''' in the [[Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
body.name: Scourge of Scarabs
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening a chest in one of the reward rooms after defeating the [[Ancient Spawn of Morgathla]] ([[Dangerous Depths Quest]]).

body.description: You don't care for rules that others set up and shape the world to your liking. Having left behind meaningless conventions and morals, you prize only the power you wield. You're a master of your fate and battle to cleanse the world.
body.name: Dread Lord
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the rank of Dread Lord of the [[Brotherhood of Bones]] faction in the [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]].

body.description: Urgh! Close the windows! Shut out the sun rearing its ugly yellow head, shut out the earsplitting laughter of your neighbour's corpulent children. Ahhh. Embrace sweet darkness and silence.
body.name: Do Not Disturb
body.spoiler: Obtainable by closing house [[windows]] 100 times.

body.description: You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
body.name: Hat Hunter
body.spoiler: Complete the [[Ferumbras' Ascension Quest]].

body.description: You are quite curious about these echoes.
body.name: Echo Initiate
body.spoiler: Obtained after triggering an [[Echo Raid]] for the first time.

body.description: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
body.name: Like Fox and Mouse
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Foxmouse]].

body.description: Oh, the joy of riding! You've just got your very first own mount. Conveniently enough you don't even need stables, but can summon it any time you like.
body.name: Natural Born Cowboy
body.spoiler: Obtainable after gaining first mount.

body.description: Rise and shine! It's a beautiful new day - open your windows, feel the warm sunlight, watch the birds singing on your windowsill and care for your plants. What reason is there not to be happy?
body.name: Let the Sunshine In
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening house [[windows]] 100 times.

body.description: Wow - what was that? You don't know how you ended up here, but somehow you did. How to get from Beregar to Kazordoon in a jiffy - that's something those dwarves would love to know, but you're not quite sure how to reproduce it.
body.history: This achievement was accidentaly discovered by {{Character|Rosk Roll}} with the help of {{Character|Mirius}} on November 10, 2021, many years after its introduction to the game. In a {{Post|39248052|statement}} on the following day, CM Skerio said that it was ''an unintended side effect of a change that the achievement "Unlikely Pathfinder" has become widely available'', implying that the original method of obtaining the achievement is different than the one players discovered. Because many players obtained the achievement, CipSoft decided that no further changes would be made to it.
body.name: Unlikely Pathfinder
body.spoiler:
Obtained by travelling from Beregar to Kazordoon through the Wagon Maze.
In order to get the achievement, you must set the Wagon Maze to the north-west exit, like the image below, and then use the wagon at the entrance. [[File:Unlikely Pathfinder.png|400px]]

body.description: Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
body.name: All Hail the King
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Thais]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
body.name: Fabled Construction
body.spoiler: Obtained by building a [[Glooth Glider]].

body.description: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
body.name: Friendly Fire
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the complete [[Fire-Fighter Outfits]].

body.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
body.name: Snake Pit
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Marapur]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You extinguished 500 thornfires! You were there when the Firestarters took over Shadowthorn. You saved the day - and the home of some elves which will try to kill you nonetheless. Isn't it nice to see everything restored just as it was before..?
body.name: Firefighter
body.spoiler: Obtained by extinguishing 500 fires during the [[Thornfire]] world change.

body.description: Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
body.name: Top CGB Agent
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Secret Service Quest]] for the [[CGB]] faction.

body.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
body.name: Gnomelike
body.spoiler: Obtainable by reaching rank III of [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: You freed the captive forest fury from the Corym Black Market. A friend in need is a friend indeed!
body.name: A Friend in Need
body.relatedpages: [[Threatened Dreams Quest#Sweet Dreams|Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams]]
body.spoiler: Obtained after successfully freeing [[A Captive Forest Fury]] during the [[Threatened Dreams Quest#Sweet Dreams|Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams]].

body.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
body.name: Noblesse Obliterated
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[Prince Drazzak]] in the [[Roshamuul Prison]].

body.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
body.name: Dream's Over
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Tormentor]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Tormentor]].

body.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
body.name: Nestling
body.spoiler: For killing [[Mamma Longlegs]] 3 times.

body.description: But close your eyes and don't tell anyone what you wished for, or it won't come true!
body.name: Make a Wish
body.spoiler: Obtainable by blowing out the candle of 5 [[Party Cake]]s.

body.description: You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
body.name: You Don't Know Jack
body.spoiler: Obtainable by lying to [[Jack]] after finishing [[Jack to the Future Quest]].

body.description: You followed the Three-Fold Path as did generations of Merudri before you. Carry the legacy, culture and hope of the Merudri proudly into this realm, the hearts of its people and beyond.
body.name: Hope of the Merudri
body.spoiler: Obtained by touching all the ancient shrines in [[The Way of the Monk Quest]].

body.description: You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you.
body.name: Ghostwhisperer
body.relatedpages: [[Ghost]], [[Ghost of a Priest]], [[A Wandering Soul]], [[Tylaf]], [[A Restless Soul]]
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by:
* Talking to [[Ghost of a Priest]] in the 4th mission of the [[Wrath of the Emperor Quest]]; * Talking to [[A Wandering Soul]] in the 5th mission of the [[Blood Brothers Quest]]; and * Talking to [[A Restless Soul]] in the Formorgar Mines 1 mission of the [[Ice Islands Quest]].

body.description: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
body.name: Malefitz
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by delivering [[Fitzwilliam's Special Reserve]] to [[Fitzmaurice]].<noinclude>

# First go to [[Bounac]], find [[Fitzmaurice]] and ask him about {{KW|wine}}. 
# Then travel to the [[Cobra Bastion]], find [[Fitzgerald]] and ''use'' him until he gives you the bottle of [[Fitzwilliam's Special Reserve]].
# Return to Bounac and deliver the {{KW|wine}} to Fitzmaurice.
</noinclude>

body.description: You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
body.name: Rift Warrior
body.spoiler: Complete the [[Rift Warrior Outfits Quest]].

body.description: It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
body.name: Dragon Mimicry
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Dragonling]].

body.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
body.name: Spareribs for Dinner
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Ribstride]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Ribstride]].

body.description: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
body.name: Honorary Rascoohan
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of [[Rascoohan Outfits]].

body.description: You're a humble warrior who doesn't need wealth or specialised equipment for travelling and fighting. You feel at home in the northern lands of Zao and did your part in fighting its corruption.
body.name: Peazzekeeper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Wayfarer Outfits]].

body.description: You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
body.history: Up until {{OfficialNewsArchive|4449|16 January, 2018}}, unlocking a creature categorized as trivial would not grant you this achievement.
body.name: Hunting Permit
body.spoiler: Obtainable by fully unlocking any monster in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
body.name: Stepped on a Big Toe
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Tromphonyte]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Tromphonyte]].

body.description: Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
body.name: Dungeon Cleaner
body.spoiler: Obtainable by clearing the first 3 [[Warzones]].

body.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
body.name: Shell We Take a Ride
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Shellodon]] mount.

body.description: Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
body.name: Gryphon Rider
body.spoiler: Obtainable by taming a [[Gryphon]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Archer
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Bow]].

body.description: The wrath of the Noxious Spawn - you accidentally managed to incur it. Your days are counted and your death inevitable. Sometime. Someplace.
body.name: Cursed!
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by getting cursed by the [[Claw of 'The Noxious Spawn']].

'''Note''': you have to ''use'' it several times to get cursed, not equip it. It can take many tries to get cursed or poisoned by the claw, watch out not be afk at lower levels since the damage from the curse can be high.

body.description: Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
body.name: Library Liberator
body.spoiler: Obtainable upon killing [[The Scourge of Oblivion]].

body.description: You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story.
body.name: Vive la Resistance
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the Daily Task of [[Children of the Revolution Quest]].

body.description: Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
body.name: Lost Palace Raider
body.spoiler: Complete [[The Lost Brother Quest]] and the [[Asura Palace Quest]].

body.description: You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
body.name: King of the Jungle
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Tiquanda]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
body.name: Release the Kraken
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Krakoloss]] [[mount]].

body.description: You answered the call of the moon goddess and thwarted the asuri's plans. Yet the echoes will linger, and the whisper of the moonsilver is now a part of Marapur.
body.name: Amati's Echo
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing  [[Shards of a Broken Moon Quest]].

body.description: You're one of the few Tibians who Armenius chose to actually show his true face to - and he made you fight him. Either that means you're very lucky or very unlucky, but one thing's for sure - it's extremely rare.
body.name: His True Face
body.spoiler:
There's a small chance of getting this achievement during the mission 3 of the [[Blood Brothers Quest]]: if you're lucky, he teleports you to his basement when you leave his tavern after talking to him. This can also happen when entering or leaving the bar after completing the mission.
[[File:Armenius True Face.png|left|frame|A player getting His True Face achievement upon being teleported to Armenius basement.]]

body.description: Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
body.name: Mind the Dog!
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Modified Gnarlhound]].

body.description: Either you are not a fast learner or you find some pleasure in setting yourself on fire. Or you're just looking for a fancy title. In any case, you should know that passing gas during your little donkey experiments is not recommended.
body.name: Rocket in Pocket
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 3 [[Fireworks Rocket]]s in your backpack or inside of a corpse.

body.description: Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
body.name: Forbidden Knowledge
body.spoiler: Obtained by using a {{Ilink|Key to Knowledge}} [[Key to Knowledge]] on the {{Ilink|Forbidden Tome}} [[Forbidden Tome]], both of which will be consumed; this ''won't'' work if you have never eaten a {{Ilink|Forbidden Fruit}} [[Forbidden Fruit]].

body.description: Longterm relationships are just not for you. And each time you think you're in love, you're proven wrong shortly afterwards. Or maybe you just end up with the wrong lover each time - exploited and betrayed. Staying single might just be better.
body.name: Commitment Phobic
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting a [[divorce]] 3 times. Note: You have to file for divorce yourself in order to obtain the achievement.

body.description: You sacrificed a lot of ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches and played a significant part in the efforts to repel the dreaded banebringers. The drawback is that even the banebringers may take notice of you ...
body.name: Banebringers' Bane
body.spoiler: Obtainable by throwing 50 ingredients into the witches cauldron during the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: Okay, let's face it - as long as you believe it could potentially lead you to the biggest treasure ever, you won't let go of that map, however fishy it might look. There must be a secret behind all of this!
body.name: Slim Chance
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Treasure Map]] 100 times.

body.description: With a perfectly harmless smile you fooled all of those wisecrackers into eating your exploding cookies. Consider a boy or girl scout outfit next time to make the trick even better.
body.name: Allow Cookies?
body.spoiler: Obtainable by delivering [[Exploding Cookie]]s to [[Avar Tar]], [[Simon the Beggar]], [[Ariella]], [[Lorbas]], [[Markwin]], [[Hjaern]], [[Wyda]], [[Hairycles]] and [[Orc King]] during {{Spoiler Section|What a Foolish Quest|Mission 10 - A Sweet Surprise}}. It is not necessary to deliver an exploding cookie to [[Yaman]] or [[Nah'Bob]] in order to get this achievement.

body.description: You probably don't know anymore how you really look like - usually when you look into a mirror, some kind of monster stares back at you. On the other hand - maybe that's an improvement?
body.name: Masquerader
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 100 [[Costume Bag]]s of [[Stan]].

body.description: At daytime you can be found camouflaged in the woods laying traps or chasing big game, at night you're sitting by the campfire and sharing your hunting stories. You eat what you hunted and wear what you skinned. Life could go on like that forever.
body.name: Hunting with Style
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Hunter Outfits]].

body.description: You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead!
body.name: Huntsman (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the rank of Huntsman in the [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], Paw and Fur Ranks.

body.description: The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
body.name: Gnomebane's Bane
body.spoiler: Obtained after opening the treasure chest of [[Gnomevil]] for the first time after slaying him.

body.description: Every city should be proud to call someone like you its inhabitant. You're keeping the streets clean and help settling the usual disputes in front of the depot. Also, you probably own a cat and like hiking.
body.name: Exemplary Citizen
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Citizen Outfits]].

body.description: Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
body.name: Jewel in the Swamp
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Venore]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
body.name: Little Ball of Wool
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Black Sheep]].

body.description: Aren't you just perfectly, wonderfully, beautifully gorgeous? You can't pass a mirror without admiring your looks. Or maybe doing a quick check whether something's stuck in your teeth, perhaps?
body.name: Vanity
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Wall Mirror]]s 300 times. Note that getting the message ''Don't be so vain'' does not count towards the achievement, which is why being [[drunk]] in order to eliminate the possibility of this message appearing will save a lot of time. Also note that it is impossible to gain this achievement through the use of wall mirrors that spawn as objects in-game, such as the one above the [[Swamp Troll Cave]] near [[Venore]].

body.description: By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
body.name: Gatherer
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Dissolved Chitin|Dissolved Chitin]] task 10 times.

body.description: You've joined the undead bone brothers - making death your enemy and your weapon as well. Devouring what's weak and leaving space for what's strong is your primary goal.
body.name: Bone Brother
body.relatedpages: [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]], [[Brotherhood of Bones]], [[Brotherhood of Bones Outfits Quest]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by joining to the [[Brotherhood of Bones]] in the [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]].

body.description: Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails.
body.name: The Rootwalker
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Rootwalker Outfits]].

body.description: Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
body.name: Goo Goo Dancer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 100 [[Muck Remover]]s on [[Mucus Plug]]s.

body.description: Modifying Brewmaster Bhaan's Raubritter Lager with a hint of Night Harpy, you received a potent remedy against their vicious attacks. Drinking so much of it however, you wonder what other side effects it has as you stare at the moon... mesmerised...
body.history: This achievement was discovered by {{Character|Shayddex}} on March 19, 2026 and shared on the official forums on {{Post|39575629}}.
body.name: Stagmeister
body.spoiler: Drink 20 {{ilink|Bottle of Enhanced Raubritter Lager}} [[Bottle of Enhanced Raubritter Lager]].

body.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
body.name: Stomach Ulcer
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Disrupt The Hives Digestion|Disrupt The Hives Digestion]] task 100 times

body.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
body.name: Grinding Again
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the grindstone mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
body.name: Bounacean Chivalry
body.spoiler: Obtained by using the [[Violet Tulip]] Kesar gave you next to [[Yselda]] after defeating [[Megasylvan Yselda]] while keeping her [[Megasylvan Sapling|Megasylvan Saplings]] alive.

body.description: You feel at home under the hot desert sun with sand between your toes, and your favourite means of travel is a flying carpet. Also, you can probably do that head isolation dance move.
body.name: One Thousand and One
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Oriental Outfit]].

body.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
body.name: Crystal Keeper
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Crystal Keeper mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Things you do... for science.
body.history: This achievement was discovered by {{Character|Marcus Eon}} on January 16, 2025.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/TibiaMMO/comments/1i2nl6g/congratulations_you_earned_the_achievement/ Marcus' Reddit post]</ref>
body.name: Holzkopf
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 100 {{ilink|Demon Root}} [[Demon Root]]s.

body.description: You have spent 70.000.000 gold overall to fund the Great Expedition. Congratulations for helping to make this dream come true!
body.name: Stakeholder
body.spoiler: Donate 70.000.000 gold to [[The Great Expedition]]

body.description: You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
body.name: Breaking the Ice
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Shardhead]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Shardhead]].

body.description: Six. Six. Six.
body.name: Number of the Beast
body.spoiler: Obtainable by rolling a 6 three times in a row with a [[die]].

body.description: You’ve probably never gotten seasick in your life — you love spending your free time on the ocean and covered quite a lot of miles with ships. Aren’t you glad you didn’t have to swim all that?
body.name: Ship's Kobold
body.spoiler: Obtainable by travelling by [[ship]] around 1250 times. <noinclude>The cheapest cheapest option is to travel between [[Edron]] and [[Cormaya]] which costs around 25,000 [[gp]] if you have completed mission 6 of the [[Postman Missions Quest]]. However, it takes around 2500 journeys by this route because only one way counts. On the other hand, the fastest option is to travel between [[Edron]] and [[Venore]], but it costs around 37,500 [[gp]] (if you have Postman's discount).</noinclude>

body.description: You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
body.name: Luminous Kitty
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting a [[Blazebringer|very special present]] from [[Santa Claus]].

body.description: You love the moment right before your rocket takes off and explodes into beautiful colours - not only on new year's eve!
body.name: Fireworks in the Sky
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 250 [[Fireworks Rocket]]s on the floor (doesn't count if used in your backpack/container).

body.description: You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
body.name: Honest Finder
body.spoiler: Obtained by returning a [[Bag with Stolen Gold]] to a [[bank]] when the [[Bank Robbery Mini World Change]] is active.

body.description: And anyone claiming otherwise is a liar.
body.name: The Cake's the Truth
body.spoiler: Obtainable by Baking 30 [[Cake]]s.

body.description: You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
body.name: High and Dry
body.spoiler: Obtainable by shipwrecking 30 times after asking for a ''shortcut'' to captain [[Charles]] (you must wait 20 hours to ask for a shortcut again after shipwrecking).

body.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
body.name: Sleepwalking
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the missions [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#A Cup of Tea|A Cup of Tea]], [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#Ancient Dreams|Ancient Dreams]] and [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#Waters of Life|Waters of Life]] during the [[Roshamuul Quest]].

body.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
body.name: Guardian Downfall
body.spoiler: Obtainable for killing 300 [[Deepling Guard]]s.

body.description: Your outstanding work towards the launch of the Great Expedition turned out well for you. You decided it's time to take a break and the Landsailer for a spin! May you always have wind in your sails and a hand-width of even ground under your wheels!
body.name: Sail Away!
body.spoiler: Obtaining [[Landsailer]] mount

body.description: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
body.name: Ritualist
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of the [[Summoner Outfits]] on a male character or both addons of [[Mage Outfits]] on a female character.

body.description: You've daringly jumped into the infamous Annihilator and survived - taking home fame, glory and your reward.
body.name: Annihilator
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Annihilator Quest]].

body.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
body.name: Rathleton Commoner
body.spoiler: Obtained by reaching the rank of '''Commoner''' in the [[Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
body.name: Cave Completionist
body.spoiler: Obtain the [[Cave Explorer Outfits]] and both of its addons.

body.description: You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right??
body.name: Perfect Fool
body.spoiler: Obtainable by doing [[What a foolish Quest]].

body.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
body.name: Kapow!
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Bruise Payne]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Bruise Payne]].

body.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
body.name: Dream Warden
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Dream Warden Outfits]] with both addons.

body.description: On top of a cloud, the sun is always shining.
body.name: Radiant Nimbus
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Radiant Nimbus (Mount)|Radiant Nimbus]].

body.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
body.name: Stronghold of Edron
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Edron]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: The [[Soulpit]] resonates as the spirit of your final foe shatters under your might.
body.name: Soul Crusher
body.spoiler: Obtained by unlocking [[Animus Mastery]] for at least one creature in each [[bestiary]] [[Bestiary/Classes|class]] in the [[Soulpit]].

body.description: Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
body.name: Sharpshooter (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking ''100'' [[Bullseye Potion]]s.

body.description: You've proven to be a valuable ally to the Marid, and Gabel welcomed you to trade with Haroun and Nah'Bob whenever you want to. Though the Djinn war has still not ended, the Marid can't fail with you on their side.
body.name: Marid Ally
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Djinn War - Marid Faction]].

body.description: You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
body.name: Something Smells
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Sulphur Scuttler]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Sulphur Scuttler]].

body.description: You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centered power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward.
body.name: Nightmare Knight
body.spoiler: Obtainable by joining to the [[Nightmare Knights]] in the [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]].

body.description: You managed to kill more than four hundred white deer - it looks like you are one of the main reasons they will soon be considered extinct, way to go!
body.name: Deer Hunt
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 400 [[White Deer]] ([[Enraged White Deer|enraged]] or [[Desperate White Deer|desperate]]).

body.description: Sometimes the biggest secrets of life can have a simple solution.
body.name: Mathemagician
body.spoiler: Obtainable by talking with "A Prisoner" in [[Paradox Tower Quest]].

body.description: Staking vampires and demons has almost turned into your profession. You make sure to gather even the tiniest amount of evil dust particles. Beware of silicosis.
body.name: Ashes to Dust
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Blessed Wooden Stake|blessed wooden stake]] 500 times successfully on slain demons and/or slain vampires (including [[Vampire|Vampires]], [[Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides]], and [[Vampire Viscount|Vampire Viscounts]]).

body.description: You caught fifty rare shimmer swimmers. Getting rid of all those corpses by dumping them into the lake really was worth it, wasn't it? Wait, didn't something move in the water just now...?
body.name: Biodegradable
body.spoiler: Obtainable by fishing 50 [[Shimmer Swimmer]]s.

body.description: The breeze in your hair, your fingers clutching the rim of your carpet - that's how you like to travel. Faster! Higher! And a looping every now and then.
body.name: High-Flyer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by travelling by [[Magic Carpet]] 1000 times. '''Tip:''' [[Edron]] - [[Darashia]] is the cheapest route: '''40 [[gp]]''' per trip ('''30 gp''' if you have done the [[Postman Quest]]).

body.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
body.name: Trip to the Beach
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Quirefang]] as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
body.name: Fall of the Fallen
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening [[Gnomevil]]'s reward chest 50 times.

body.description: Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
body.name: Dwarven Mines (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Kazordoon]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
body.name: Champion of Winter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 20 bosses at the [[Dream Scar]] as part of [[The Dream Courts Quest]] when fighting for the Winter Dreamelves.

body.description: You helped bringing Devovorga's dangerous tentacles and her humongous cocoon down - not stopping her transformation, but ultimately completing a crucial step to her death.
body.name: Cocoon of Doom
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with a [[Bloom of Doom]] during the [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]].

body.description: You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
body.name: Bewitcher
body.spoiler: Obtainable by reaching 750 favour points during the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
body.name: The Professor's Nut
body.spoiler: Obtained by opening the chest after completing the [[Hero of Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
body.history: Although the outfits were implemented on [[Updates/11.50|Update 11.50]], this achievement was only implemented on [[Updates/11.53|Update 11.53]].
body.name: Cobbled and Patched
body.relatedpages: [[Makeshift Warrior Outfits]], [[Plan for a Makeshift Armour]], [[Crude Wood Planks]], [[Tinged Pot]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Makeshift Warrior Outfits]].

body.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
body.name: The Drowned Sea God
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Leviathan]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Leviathan]].

body.description: There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
body.name: Fata Morgana
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Dromedary]].

body.description: One special hero among many. This year - it was you. Devovorga withdrew in a darker realm because she could not withstand your power - and that of your comrades. Time will tell if the choice you made was good - but for now, it saved your world.
body.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Devovorga]] during the [[Rise of Devovorga]] World Quest.

body.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
body.name: Twisted Mutation
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Esmeralda]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Esmeralda]].

body.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
body.name: Back from the Dead
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Zanakeph]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Zanakeph]].

body.description: You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on.
body.name: Honorary Barbarian
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Barbarian Test Quest]].

body.description: Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
body.name: Elementary, My Dear
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking a [[Pint of Glooth]] and accessing Dr Merlay's hideout during ''Dr Merlay's Misery Task'' in the [[Oramond Quest]].

body.description: Your map is your friend — always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it — but luckily there's no way to take it from you.
body.name: Territorial
body.spoiler: Obtainable by asking [[Guide Alexena]] ([[Carlin]]), [[Guide Behil]] ([[Darashia]]), [[Guide Davina]] ([[Liberty Bay]]), [[Guide Edna]] ([[Yalahar]]), [[Guide Elena]] ([[Venore]]), [[Guide Jonathan]] ([[Edron]]), [[Guide Luke]] ([[Thais]]), [[Guide Rahlkora]] ([[Ankrahmun]]), [[Guide Thelandil]] ([[Ab'dendriel]]), and [[Guide Tiko]] ([[Port Hope]]) to mark your [[automap]].

body.description: Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your post horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs!
body.name: Archpostman
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing [[The Postman Missions Quest]].

body.description: That's almost too much luck for one person. If something's really, really rare - it probably falls into your lap sooner or later. Congratulations!
body.name: Lucky Devil
body.relatedpages: [[Fishing Rod]], [[Water Elemental]], [[Massive Water Elemental]], [[Flask of Rust Remover]], [[Slightly Rusted Armor]]
body.spoiler:
To get this achievement you need to fish a [[Leviathan's Amulet]] from the corpse of a [[Water Elemental]] or [[Massive Water Elemental]] AND unrust a [[Golden Armor]] out of a [[Slightly Rusted Armor]].
{{seealso|Water Elemental/Fishing Statistics|Massive Water Elemental/Fishing Statistics|Slightly Rusted Armor/Unrusting Statistics}}

body.description: Your efforts in fighting back the banebringers has not gone unnoticed. You are a legend amongst the witches and your name is whispered with awe and admiration.
body.name: Honorary Witch
body.spoiler: Obtainable by throwing 500 ingredients into the witches cauldron during the [[Bewitched]] event.

body.description: By the gods! What was that?
body.name: Something's in There
body.spoiler: Obtainable by stepping on a hole in any [[Fallen Tree (Something)]] or [[Mossy Fallen Tree (Something)]] when eyes appear. In the tree located {{Mapper Coords|127.195|127.231|7|4|text=here}}, eyes appear every other second.

body.description: Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
body.name: Swashbuckler
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Pirate Outfits]].

body.description: You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
body.name: Museum Goer
body.spoiler: Obtained by defeating [[Mitmah Vanguard]] for the first time.

body.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
body.name: Gnome Friend
body.spoiler: Obtainable by advancing to rank II in the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
body.history: This achievement was added in the [[Summer Update 2021]], but it could not be obtained because only one addon could be acquired. After the [[Winter Update 2025]] it was possible to get both addons, and the achievement became obtainable.
body.name: King's Council
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting both addons of the [[Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits]].

body.description: You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
body.name: Fire from the Earth
body.spoiler: Obtainable for killing 50 fiery [[creatures]] in and on the [[Hellgore]] volcano during the [[Fire from the Earth Mini World Change]].

body.description: You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
body.name: Ender of the End
body.spoiler: Complete the [[Heart of Destruction Quest]].

body.description: You proved yourself - not only in your dreams - and possess a strong and spiritual mind. Your valorous fight against demons and the undead plague has granted you the highest and most respected rank among the Nightmare Knights.
body.name: Lord Protector
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the rank of Lord Protector of the [[Nightmare Knights]] faction in the [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]].

body.description: Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
body.history: Although the outfits were implemented on [[Updates/11.80|Update 11.80]], this achievement was only implemented on [[Updates/11.86|Update 11.86]].
body.name: Exalted Battle Mage
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Battle Mage Outfits]].

body.description: Apparently not all chests are the same. Some have a life of their own and if you think about it... how do so many of them actually refill every day? Well, you're one step closer to revealing this secret
body.history: This achievement was discovered by {{Character|Marcus Eon}} on June 21, 2026 and shared with a post on [https://www.reddit.com/r/TibiaMMO/comments/1ubkoc9/110524_congratulations_you_earned_the_achievement/ Reddit].
body.name: Mimic (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by clicking 20 [[Mimic]]s in [[Isle of Ada]].

body.description: Riding such an ancient beast is certainly a good and harmless idea.
body.name: Fiend Rider
body.spoiler: Obtained by using a [[Demon in a Green Box]] and taming a [[Primal Demonosaur]].

body.description: You love to hang out in cold surroundings and consider ice the best material to be shaped. What a waste to use ice cubes for drinks when you can create a beautiful mammoth statue from it!
body.name: Ice Sculptor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by sculpting an [[Ice Mammoth]] from [[Ice Cube]]s by using an [[Obsidian Knife]] on it.

body.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
body.name: Well Roared, Lion!
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[White Lion (Mount)|White Lion]]

body.description: What is best in life? To crush your enemies. To see them driven before you. And to maybe have a nice cup of tea afterwards.
body.name: Brutal Politeness
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Barbarian Outfits]].

body.description: You begin your day by bathing in your pot of gold and you don't mind showing off your wealth while strolling the streets in your best clothes - after all it's your hard-earned money! You prefer to be addressed with 'Your Highness'.
body.name: Aristocrat
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Nobleman Outfits]].

body.description: Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
body.name: Areas of Effect
body.spoiler: Obtainable by donating a total of 1 million gold to [[Cyclopedia#Improved_Respawn_Rate|improve]] the spawn rate of one or more areas.

body.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
body.name: Gnomish Art Of War
body.spoiler: Gaining permanent access to the warzones in the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: The pen is mightier than the sword. In a way, yes, you have had this experience. You have seen with your own eyes what the power of words can do, the written word, to be precise.
body.name: Power of Words
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the [[Between the Lines Quest]].

body.description: You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
body.name: Rumble in the Plant
body.spoiler: Obtained by defeating the [[Tremor Worm]].

body.description: You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better than ever could. Keep those hormones flowing!
body.name: Matchmaker
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing {{Spoiler Section|The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest|Mission 3: Love's a Wicked Game}}, or by completing {{Spoiler Section|The Shattered Isles Quest|Breaking the Spell}} (Access to [[Laguna Islands]]).

body.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
body.name: Scorched Flames
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Flameborn]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Flameborn]].

body.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
body.name: Widely Travelled
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the basic [[Discoverer Outfits]].

body.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
body.name: Becoming a Bigfoot
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Recruitment mission in the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
body.name: Umbral Master
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating all of the Master [[Umbral Weapons]].

body.description: You live the life of hunters and gatherers. Well, especially that of a gatherer, and especially of one who gathers lots of blueberries. Have you checked the colour of your tongue lately?
body.name: Bluebarian
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Blueberry Bush]]es 500 times.

body.description: Stealth kills and backstabbing are you specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
body.name: Swift Death
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Assassin Outfits]].

body.description: You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
body.name: Dog Sitter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finding the [[King Tibianus|King's]] dog [[Noodles]] during the [[Noodles is Gone Mini World Change]].

body.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Skilled Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 10 hard monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: Your local magic trader considers you one of his best customers - you usually buy large stocks of potions so you won't wake up in the middle of the night craving for more. Yet, you always seem to run out of them too fast. Cheers!
body.name: Potion Addict
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking 100,000 [[potions]] that regenerate mana, 100,000 potions that regenerate health or 100,000 potions that regenerate both mana and health points.

body.description: Few things equal the wild fury of a trapped and riven creature. You were a worthy opponent.
body.name: Slayer of Irahsae
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Irahsae]] during [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]] or [[Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change]].

body.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
body.name: Gravedigger (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing [[The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest]].

body.description: If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
body.name: Goldhunter
body.spoiler: Obtained by returning 5 [[Bag with Stolen Gold|Bags with Stolen Gold]] in total when the [[Bank Robbery Mini World Change]] is active.

body.description: You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
body.name: Cartography 101
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the [[Cartography 101 Quest]].

body.description: You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
body.name: Warlock (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Wizard Outfits]].

body.description: The echoes are beginning to infiltrate your dreams.
body.name: Echo Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtained after triggering 50 [[Echo Raid]]s.

body.description: Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
body.name: Pecking Order
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Terror Bird]].

body.description: You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
body.name: Meat Skewer
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[The Bloodtusk]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Bloodtusk]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Bladelord
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Slayer]].

body.description: RAWR! Strength running through your body, your heart racing faster and adrenaline fueling your every weapon swing. All in a little bottle. No refund for destroyed furniture. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
body.name: Berserker (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by drinking 100 [[Berserk Potion]]s.

body.description: Ah, the smell of the sea! Standing at the shore and casting a line is one of your favourite activities. For you, fishing is relaxing - and at the same time, providing easy food. Perfect!
body.name: Here, Fishy Fishy!
body.spoiler: Obtainable by fishing 1000 [[Fish]] or, during the [[Twisted Waters World Change]], [[Fishbone|Fishbones]]. '''Note:''' [[Ice Fishing]] doesn't count.

body.description: Take an ice cube and an obsidian knife and you'll very likely shape something really pretty from it. Mostly cute little mammoths, which are a hit with all the girls.
body.name: Cold as Ice
body.spoiler: Obtainable by sculpting 10 [[Ice Mammoth]]s from [[Ice Cube]]s by using an [[Obsidian Knife]] on them.

body.description: You are now the royal archfiend of the Askarak, prince slayer.
body.name: Askarak Nemesis
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing 100 [[Askarak Prince]].

body.description: You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
body.name: Nevermending Story
body.spoiler: Obtainable by [[fishing]] all 11 [[Message in a Bottle|Messages in a Bottle]] out of the water during the [[Roshamuul Quest]] and then finding the first mate.

body.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
body.name: The Serpent's Bride
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Gorgo]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Gorgo]].

body.description: You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
body.name: Down the Drain
body.spoiler: Obtainable for killing 50 [[water elemental]]s in [[Outlaw Camp/Water Elemental Dungeon]] during [[Down the Drain Mini World Change]].

body.description: The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
body.name: Death from Below
body.spoiler: Obtained after opening the treasure chest of [[Abyssador]] for the first time after slaying it.

body.description: Liberty Bay is the perfect hangout for you and harvesting sugar cane quite a relaxing leisure activity. Would you like some tea with your sugar, hon?
body.name: Natural Sweetener
body.spoiler: Obtainable by cutting 50 [[Sugar Cane]]s.

body.description: Lalalala... you now know the cult's hymn sung in Liberty Bay by heart. Not that hard, considering that it mainly consists of two notes and repetitive lyrics.
body.name: Chorister
body.spoiler: Obtainable by learning all four [[Music Sheet]]s.

body.description: Not even the hostile underwater environment stops you from doing your duty for the Explorer Society. Scouting the Quara realm is a piece of cake for you.
body.name: Sea Scout
body.spoiler: Obtainable by doing The Undersea Kingdom and The Frozen Trench missions in [[The Explorer Society Quest]].

body.description: You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast.
body.name: Animal Activist
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by doing {{Spoiler Section|The Ice Islands Quest|Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage}} AND {{Spoiler Section|Meriana Quest|Tortoise Egg from Nargor Mission}}.
'''Note:''' If you did both these missions and still haven't received the [[achievement]], kill some [[Husky|Huskies]] in [[Svargrond]] and then pay your fine to [[Iskan]].

body.description: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
body.name: Plant vs. Minos
body.spoiler: Obtained by helping to defeat the [[Moohtant Wallbreaker]].

body.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain. Despite the perils, you and your fellow crewmen have braved the challenge.
body.name: Ghost Sailor
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing 1 journey in [[A Pirate's Death to Me]].

body.description: There... is... simply... no... better... way - than to travel on the back of a turtle. At least you get to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Laguna.
body.name: Quick as a Turtle
body.spoiler: Obtainable by travelling by the [[Sea Turtle|sea turtle]] on [[Laguna Islands]] 2000 times. (about 25-30 min non-stop).

body.description: You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
body.name: True Colours
body.spoiler: Obtainable by participating in the [[The Colours of Magic]] event three times (colors don't matter).

body.description: This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
body.name: No Horse Open Sleigh
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by receiving a [[Bright Percht Sleigh]], a [[Cold Percht Sleigh]] '''or''' a [[Dark Percht Sleigh]].

'''Note''': You can obtain the 3 different Sleighs, but there is only one achievement given for the first one you chose.

body.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
body.name: Rathleton Squire
body.spoiler: Obtained by reaching the rank of '''Squire''' in the [[Rathleton Quest]].

body.description: Tired... so tired... curling up in a warm and cosy bed seems like the perfect thing to do right now. Sweet dreams!
body.name: Mister Sandman
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[bed]] or a [[cot]] 500 times (logging out).

body.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
body.name: Thick-Skinned
body.spoiler: Obtained by obtaining a [[Stampor (Mount)]] from [[Chondur]].

body.description: Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
body.name: Minor Disturbance
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Antenna Blinding|Antenna Blinding]] task 10 times.

body.description: Almost all the plants you tested for Chartan in Zao where inedible - you tasted them all, yet you're still standing! You should really get some fresh air now, though.
body.name: Extreme Degustation
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making the Daily Task of Children of the Revolution Quest [[Children of the Revolution Quest/Spoiler#Daily Task: Collect|Collect]].

body.description: Many letters have been written by knights of the Order of the Stag. Some personal while others were simply a mistake. We often ask ourselves what happened to these once corresponding souls, we hope for the best but have to fear for the worst.
body.name: Lost Letters
body.spoiler: Obtainable by reading all personal letters from the Isle of Ada mini bosses.

body.description: Sometimes you feel there's a gremlin in there. So many lottery tickets, so many blanks? That's just not fair! Share your misery with the world.
body.name: Jinx
body.spoiler: Obtainable by opening 500 blank [[Lottery Ticket]]s (winning tickets don't count).

body.description: Uhm... who's that person who you just woke up beside? Broken cocktail glasses on the floor, flowers all over the room, and why the heck are you wearing a ring? Yesterday must have been a long, weird day...
body.name: The Day After
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting married while being drunk. Note that you must be drunk during the entire ceremony, and you got to be the second player saying 'hi' to the NPC in order to get the achievement.

body.description: You won the merciless 2 vs. 2 team tournament on the Isle of Strife and wiped out wave after wave of fearsome opponents. Death or victory - you certainly chose the latter.
body.name: Champion of Chazorai
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing mission 9 of [[The New Frontier Quest]].

body.description: You didn't look into it - at least not for too long... but Groam did. And you relieved him. Just don't tell his friend Dronk.
body.name: Eye of the Deep
body.spoiler: Obtainable by helping to kill [[Groam]].

body.description: For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you!
body.name: Passionate Kisser
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Kissing a Pig Quest]].

body.description: Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
body.name: Glooth Engineer
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Glooth Engineer Outfits]] with both addons.

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Brawler
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Mace]].

body.description: You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
body.name: Hidden Powers
body.spoiler: Obtainable by charging a [[Helmet of the Ancients]] with a [[small ruby]].

body.description: Your little statues of Tibiasula have become quite famous around Tibia and there's few people with similar skills when it comes to shaping marble.
body.name: Marble Madness
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making five [[Beautiful Marble Statue]]s from a [[Piece of Marble Rock]].

body.description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum - homebrewed, of course, made from handpicked and personally harvested sugar cane plants. Now, let it age in an oak barrel and enjoy it in about 10 years. Or for the impatient ones: Let's have a paaaarty right now!
body.name: Homebrewed
body.relatedpages: [[Sugar Cane]], [[Bunch of Sugar Cane]], [[Fire Bug]], [[Distilling Machine]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using 50 [[Bunch of Sugar Cane|Bunches of Sugar Cane]] on a [[Distilling Machine]].

body.description: You definitely know how to bring out the best in your furniture and decoration pieces. Beautiful.
body.name: I Like it Fancy
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using a [[Small Enchanted Emerald]] on a [[Dracoyle Statue]].

body.description: You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
body.name: Hippofoddermus
body.spoiler: Obtainable by feeding 100 [[Hippo]]s with [[Reed Balls]] around [[Kilmaresh]].

body.description: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
