body.name: Nothing but Hot Air
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the [[Haze]] mount.

body.description: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
body.name: Just Cracked Me Up!
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Stonecracker]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Stonecracker]].

body.description: If someone gives you seeds, you usually grow a beautiful plant from it within a few days. You like your house green and decorated with flowers. Probably you also talk to them.
body.name: Green Thumb
body.spoiler: Obtainable by growing 100 fully developed flowers in [[Flower Pot]]s. '''Tip:''' you can reuse pots by letting the flower in it wither to then finally water it again. The flower will return to stage 2 and can then be grown to stage 3 again.

body.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
body.name: Luring Silence
body.spoiler: Obtained by finishing the mission [[Roshamuul Quest/Spoiler#Luring Silencers|Luring Silencers]] during the [[Roshamuul Quest]].

body.description: You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
body.name: Daraman's Footsteps
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Northern Darama]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You confronted the Navigator.
body.name: Navigational Error
body.spoiler: Obtainable by speaking with [[Navigator]] (during the [[Liquid Black Quest]]).

body.description: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
body.name: Measuring the World
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the second addon of the [[Discoverer Outfits]].

body.description: You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society.
body.name: Elite Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting the rank of Elite Hunter in the [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], Paw and Fur Ranks.

body.description: Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
body.name: Gear Up
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Walker]].

body.description: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
body.name: Orcsoberfest Welcome
body.spoiler:
Obtainable by winning on every game in the [[Orcsoberfest]], and also defeating [[The Great Schnitzel]] and [[King Chuck]].<noinclude>

The games are:
* Whack the Orc! (1x)
* The Great Food Race! (1x)
* Smash Nails (3x)
* Bass Fishing - catching at least one [[Bass]]
* The Eating Contest! (1x) - winning, even if there's a tie
* Sweeping Orger vomit (1x)
* Do not Feed the Porker (1x) - you have to help feeding before killing the [[Fat Porker]]. </noinclude>

body.description: Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
body.name: Moth Whisperer
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Hibernal Moth]].

body.description: You were burdened with all this soul crushing negativity and still beat Malice, Hatred, Spite, Cruelty and Greed just to help one repentant soul. But as the saying goes: No soul is left behind!
body.history: This achievement was discovered accidentally by {{Character|Teus}}, {{Character|Talin}}, {{Character|Boleight}} and {{Character|Vengelz}} on April 15, 2024.<ref>[https://clips.twitch.tv/OptimisticBlushingPheasantCclamChamp-MdJPupPpzdNZ5vQo teuzinfps' Twitch Clip]</ref>
body.name: Soul Mender
body.spoiler: Obtainable by killing [[Goshnar's Malice]], [[Goshnar's Hatred]], [[Goshnar's Spite]], [[Goshnar's Cruelty]], and [[Goshnar's Greed]] with 5 [[Goshnar's Taints]].

body.description: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
body.name: Knowledge Raider (Achievement)
body.spoiler:
Obtained by completing 50 consecutive tasks of the [[Too Hot to Handle Quest]].

Note: if you fail at any task, your progress on the achievement will be reset. Thus, it's recommended that you only try tasks you're confident you'll succeed while working on this achievement.

body.description: You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
body.name: Lion's Den Explorer
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the [[Lion's Rock Quest]].

body.description: Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
body.name: Torn Treasures
body.relatedpages: [[Mini World Changes]], [[Bored Mini World Change|Bored]], [[Wyda]], [[Torn Teddy]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by giving a random amount of [[Blood Herb]]s to [[Wyda]] until you get a [[Torn Teddy]] during the [[Bored Mini World Change]].

body.description: You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
body.name: Repenter (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtained by doing all tasks of [[The Repenters Quest]] and then asking for a bonus.

body.description: You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Serious Contender
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 100 medium monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: From rotworms in caves to dragons in the sky, no creature is safe from your overzealous swatting.
body.name: Pest Control
body.spoiler: Complete 10,000 Bounty Tasks.

body.description: Feared by your enemies, admired by many - your reputation in weapon mastery precedes you.
body.name: Arsenal of War
body.relatedpages: [[The First of Many]], [[A Well-Honed Arsenal]], [[The Forbidden Build]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by achieving Mastery in [[Weapon Proficiency]] on 50 different weapons.

body.description: One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun!
body.name: Waverider
body.spoiler: Obtainable by swimming 100,000 tiles. NOTE: it is possible to gain this achievement in Rookgaard.

body.description: Fortune tellers and horoscopes guide you through your life. And you probably wouldn't dare going on a big game hunt without your trusty voodoo skull giving you his approval for the day.
body.name: Superstitious
body.spoiler: Obtainable by using [[Mysterious Voodoo Skull]]s 100 times (message "It is not time yet." doesn't count). You can have multiple skulls and use all of them daily to speed up the process.

body.description: You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
body.name: Arachnoise
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Bloodweb]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Bloodweb]].

body.description: You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
body.name: Spectulation
body.spoiler: Obtained by entering the [[Sunken Temple]] north-west of [[Banuta]].

body.description: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
body.name: Monsterhunter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing 200 Adept [[Task Board|Weekly Kill Tasks]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Marksman
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Crossbow]].

body.description: The hungry ram devoured the whole bunch of turnips in a single bite, then looked at you as if it was ready for more. Make sure to keep it well fed along the way.
body.name: A reliable Friend
body.spoiler: Obtainable by taming the [[Reliable Ram]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Harbinger
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Master Spellbook]].

body.description: You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
body.name: Little Big Adventure
body.spoiler: Obtainable by unlocking 100 easy monsters in the [[Cyclopedia]].

body.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
body.name: Seasoned Adventurer
body.spoiler: Achieve [[level]] 50. If you have already surpassed this level, just level up once and you should get it.

body.description: And remember: Never try to teach a pig to sing. It wastes your time and annoys the pig.
body.name: Fool at Heart
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Jester Outfits]].

body.description: Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
body.name: Workhorse
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing 500 Weekly Tasks (either delivery or creature killing tasks) on the [[Task Board]].

body.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
body.name: Task Manager
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing [[Goblin Merchant Quest]] tasks 500 times.

body.description: No living fiends were hurt to achieve this outfit.
body.name: Fiend Slayer
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Fiend Slayer Outfits]].

body.description: Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
body.name: Secret Agent
body.spoiler: Obtainable by starting the [[Secret Service Quest]].

body.description: Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on!
body.name: Rockstar
body.spoiler: Obtainable by playing [[Musical Instruments]] 10,000 times. You can play different instruments and log out without resetting the counter.

body.description: When it comes to interracial understanding, you're an expert. You've mastered the language of the Chakoya and made someone really happy with your generosity. Achuq!
body.name: Jamjam
body.spoiler: Complete the [[Sinatuki Quest]].

body.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
body.name: Taskmaster
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing 500 Expert/Master [[Task Board|Weekly Kill Tasks]].

body.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
body.name: Wedding Planner
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the ''Star-Crossed Lovers'' of the [[Within the Tides Quest]].

body.description: You love fish - but preferably those caught in the cold north. Even though they're hard to come by you never get tired of picking holes in ice sheets and hanging your fishing rod in.
body.name: Exquisite Taste
body.spoiler: Obtainable by catching 250 fish through [[Ice Fishing]].

body.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
body.name: Umbral Swordsman
body.spoiler: Obtained by creating an [[Umbral Masterblade]].

body.description: By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
body.name: Starless Night
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Midnight Panther]].

body.description: You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
body.name: Treasure Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtained by opening all 20 [[Dragon Chest]]s during the [[First Dragon Quest]].

body.description: The famous 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' was probably written by you. Spending a rainy afternoon in front of the chimney, wrapped in a blanket while indulging in cocoa delights sounds just like something you'd do. Enjoy!
body.name: Sweet Tooth
body.spoiler: Obtainable by Baking 10 [[Chocolate Cake]]s.

body.description: You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
body.name: Wail of the Banshee
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing [[The Cursed Crystal Quest]].

body.description: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
body.name: First Achievement
body.spoiler: Obtained by painting a picture of the [[Colossus Fortress]] during the [[25 Years of Tibia Quest]].

body.description: You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond!
body.name: Warlord of Svargrond
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing the [[Barbarian Arena Quest]] in the Warlord difficulty.

body.description: Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
body.name: Wild Warrior (Achievement)
body.spoiler: Obtainable by getting both addons of [[Warrior Outfits]].

body.description: You stared into the Light without blinking. Foolish or enlightened... who can tell?
body.name: Enlightened, Indeed
body.spoiler: Get full [[Illuminated Warrior Outfits]]

body.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
body.name: Manic
body.spoiler: Obtainable by repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Destroy The Hive Crystals|Destroy The Hive Crystals]] 100 times.

body.description: Your deeds for Yalahar are usually characterised by deep insight and thoughtful actions. Thanks to you, Yalahar might have a chance to grow peacefully and with happy people living in it.
body.name: Yalahari of Wisdom
body.spoiler: Obtainable by receiving the good side addon from [[Palimuth]] by turning in a [[Vampiric Crest]] after having completed the [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

body.description: Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
body.name: Headache
body.spoiler: Obtainable through repeating [[War Against The Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Destroy The Hive Crystals|Destroy The Hive Crystals]] task 10 times.

body.description: Indeed, you have a soft spot for rabbits. Maybe the rabbits you saved today will be the rabbits that will save you tomorrow. When you are really hungry.
body.name: Bunny Slipped
body.relatedpages: [[Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest]], [[Fake Rabbit's Foot]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing [[Rottin Wood]]'s daily task [[Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest/Spoiler#Daily Task: Lucky Loop|Lucky Loop]], by giving 7 [[Fake Rabbit's Foot|fake rabbit's feet]] to Rottin Wood.

body.description: The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
body.name: Scales and Tail
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Draptor]].

body.description: And so it begins!
body.name: Verminbane
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing 100 Beginner [[Task Board|Weekly Kill Tasks]].

body.description: The first step to greatness has been done.
body.name: The First of Many
body.relatedpages: [[Arsenal of War]], [[A Well-Honed Arsenal]], [[The Forbidden Build]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by achieving Mastery in [[Weapon Proficiency]] on one weapon.

body.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
body.name: Confusion
body.spoiler: Obtainable by repeating [[War Against the Hive Quest/Spoiler#Mission: Destroy The Hive Crystals|Destroy The Hive Crystals]] 50 times.

body.description: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
body.name: Hissing Downfall
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[The Noxious Spawn]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[The Noxious Spawn]].

body.description: You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
body.name: Chest Robber
body.spoiler: Obtainable for picking treasures from 3 different Nomad camps during [[Nomads Mini World Change]].

body.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
body.name: Spore Hunter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Spore Collecting mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
body.name: Hot on the Trail
body.spoiler: Obtained by getting the [[Singeing Steed]] [[mount]].

body.description: Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
body.name: Mystic Predator
body.relatedpages: [[Jug of Gold Lye]], [[Idol of Tukh]], [[Polished Idol of Tukh]], [[Mystic Jaguar]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Mystic Jaguar]].

body.description: 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
body.name: Lucky Horseshoe
body.relatedpages: [[Horse Station World Change]], [[Sugar Oat]], [[Music Box]], [[Wild Horse]], [[War Horse]]
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Wild Horse]].

body.description: You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
body.name: No More Hiding
body.relatedpages: [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]], [[Paw and Fur Society]], [[Hide]]
body.spoiler: Obtainable by slaying [[Hide]].

body.description: Running barefoot across ember is not for you! You do it the elegant way. Yet, you're kind of drawn to fire and warm surroundings in general - you like it hot!
body.name: Firewalker
body.spoiler: This achievement can be gotten by walking 1,000,000 [[tiles]] on [[fire]] while wearing [[Firewalker Boots]]. Note that any type of fire field will work for this achievement (even player-made ones) as long as the fields inflict damage for the boots to block.

body.description: But can you truly be one of them?
body.name: Raider in the Dark
body.spoiler: Obtained by receiving the full [[Percht Raider Outfits]].

body.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
body.name: Never Surrender
body.spoiler: Obtained by killing 100 [[Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender]]. '''Note:''' you don't need to be the person dealing the most damage to one. Anyone participating in the fight will receive one point when it gets killed. <noinclude>You can check your progress of this achievement in your quest log under ''Roshamuul (Lower Roshamuul) > The Walls of Roshamuul''.</noinclude>

body.description: Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
body.name: Lovely Dots
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Ladybug]].

body.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
body.name: Call Me Sparky
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Spark Hunting mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: Exploring the echoes was only the beginning. Now, you conquer them.
body.name: Echo Conqueror
body.spoiler: Obtained after participating in the killing of 100 [[Echo Warden]]s (repeated ones also count).

body.description: Souls are like butterflies. The black soul of a living weapon yearning to strike lies shattered beneath your feet.
body.name: Slayer of Anmothra
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Anmothra]] during [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]] or [[Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change]].

body.description: Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
body.name: Golden Sands
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Sandstone Scorpion]].

body.description: Power lies in the will of her who commands it. You fought it with full force - and were stronger.
body.name: Slayer of Chikhaton
body.spoiler: Obtainable by significantly contributing to the battle with [[Chikhaton]] during [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]] or [[Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change]].

body.description: You have cheered up a demon baby and returned it to its mother. A quick count of your fingers will reveal if you made it through unharmed.
body.name: Baby Sitter
body.spoiler: Obtainable by successfully taking care of a [[Demon Infant]] during the [[Demon's Lullaby]] event.

body.description: You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
body.name: Robo Chop
body.spoiler: Obtained by helping to defeat the [[Glooth Bomb]].

body.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
body.name: Swamp Beast
body.spoiler: Obtained by taming a [[Water Buffalo]].

body.description: Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
body.name: Long Live the Queen
body.spoiler: Obtained by completely discovering [[Carlin]] (including its surroundings) as part of the [[Measuring Tibia Quest]].

body.description: If you see a rusty item, you can't resist polishing it. There's always a little flask of rust remover in your inventory – who knows, there might be a golden armor beneath all that dirt!
body.name: Polisher
body.spoiler: Obtainable by successfully polishing a combined total of 1000 [[Rusty Armor]]s, [[Rusty Helmet]]s, [[Rusty Legs]], and [[Rusty Shield]]s. To do that, you need to use about 1500 [[Flask of Rust Remover|Flasks of Rust Remover]].

body.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
body.name: The Call of the Wild
body.spoiler: Complete the entirety of the [[Krailos Quest]]. '''Note:''' In order to get this achievement you need all seven mission completed in your quest log '''at the same time'''. Since taking on [[Grubokk]]'s mission deletes the one the goblins give you, you are advised to do [[Grubokk]]'s one first.

body.description: You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process.
body.name: Just in Time
body.spoiler: Obtainable by finishing The Ice Delivery mission of [[The Explorer Society Quest]] and by finishing The Wednesday Mission of [[The Travelling Trader Quest]].

body.description: Trust? Love? Faithfulness? Pah! Antiquated sentiments. As long as you have fun, you do not mind stepping on lots of hearts. Preferably while wearing combat boots.
body.name: Heartbreaker
body.spoiler: While married, say ''marriage'' to one of the [[Marriage Officiant NPCs]] and tell them that your heart belongs to someone other than your marriage partner five times.

body.description: Argh! Not now! How is it that those multifunctional tools never fail when you're using them for something completely trivial like squeezing juice, but mess up when you desperately need to climb up a rope spot with a fire-breathing dragon chasing you?
body.name: Bad Timing
body.spoiler: Obtainable by jamming a [[Secret Agent Tools|secret agent tool]] 10 times. '''Tip:''' the fastest way to achieve this, is by putting your tool on a [[hotkey]] and then setting it to be used on yourself. This way you'll only have to keep that hotkey pressed down until the achievement pops up.

body.description: ... on a pegasus, to a land of honey and milk. With this beautiful flying steed you certainly can.
body.name: I Wanna Fly Away
body.relatedpages: [[Threatened Dreams Quest#Sweet Dreams|Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams]]
body.spoiler: Obtained after using a [[Pegasus Feather]], reward of the [[Threatened Dreams Quest#Sweet Dreams|Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams]].

body.description: You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
body.name: Ice Harvester
body.spoiler: Obtainable by harvesting (using) [[Ice Flower]]s and get 10 [[Ice Flower Seeds]] during the [[Thawing Mini World Change]].

body.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
body.name: One Foot Vs. Many
body.spoiler: Obtainable by completing the Monster Extermination mission of the [[Bigfoot's Burden Quest]].

body.description: True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
body.name: Guinea Pig
body.spoiler: Obtainable by making [[Research and Development Quest]] mission 2.

body.description: No matter your command, this beast is all ears!
body.name: Bat Person
body.spoiler: Obtained by completing the [[Bloody Tusks Quest]].
